items.title: 台積電產能太搶手！英特爾擴廠向前 能接住AI商機？
items.title_en: TSMC Capacity Is So Hot! Intel Pushes Forward with Plant Expansion to Capture AI Opportunities?
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US)美國晶圓廠擴建取得新進展，亞利桑那州Fab 62已開始安裝生產設備，俄亥俄州新廠也完成首座大型屋頂桁架安裝。在AI帶動晶片需求攀升之際，這些進展顯示，英特爾延宕多年的擴產計畫正逐步推進，但能否吸引足夠外部代工客戶，仍是投資回收的關鍵。

亞利桑那新廠裝機 俄亥俄廠進度仍落後

英特爾晶圓代工主管Naga Chandrasekaran周三(21日)表示，鄰近鳳凰城的Fab 62正進行設備安裝，預計2028年投入營運。鄰近的Fab 52已運作，並於2025年底量產最先進的18A製程晶片，目前主要用於英特爾自家處理器。
設備安裝是晶圓廠投產前的重要階段，也是成本最高的環節，單台設備價格可能達數億美元。相較之下，俄亥俄州新奧爾巴尼廠仍處於結構施工階段，首座大型桁架安裝完成，代表工程進入下一階段。
俄亥俄廠2022年宣布時，原定2025年開始交付晶片，如今首座廠房目標改為2030年完工，第二座預計2031年完成，較原始規劃至少落後五年。
9月曾傳出SK海力士(SKHY-US)可能租用俄亥俄廠部分空間生產記憶體，但雙方均未證實，尚不能視為已取得訂單。

AI需求帶來轉機 外部代工訂單仍待突破

英特爾執行長陳立武2025年3月上任後，對前任執行長季辛格推動的大規模擴產轉趨審慎，強調確認有足夠需求才推進新廠。如今擴建向前邁進，反映公司對未來產能需求的信心有所提升。
目前較明確的動能來自自家產品。用於AI服務的資料中心處理器訂單激增，英特爾正努力追趕需求。公司7月已將今年廠房與設備支出預算提高至約200億美元，並預期2027年將顯著增加，但仍低於華爾街估計台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)約600億美元的支出。
外部代工業務則仍待突破。英特爾尚未替亞利桑那州18A製程爭取到大型外部客戶，過去7奈米與10奈米製程延誤，也讓客戶對再次承諾下單保持謹慎。
不過，台積電先進產能吃緊，可能為英特爾創造機會。瑞穗證券分析師Jordan Klein指出，輝達(NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US)、蘋果(AAPL-US)與博通(AVGO-US)等大廠，爭取台積電產能的競爭非常激烈。
TechInsights分析師Dan Hutcheson認為，客戶希望建立第二供應來源，增加與台積電議價的籌碼。他表示，多家大廠已在英特爾進行測試，但測試能否轉化為量產訂單，仍待觀察。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) has made new progress on its U.S. wafer fab expansions: Arizona's Fab 62 has begun installing production equipment, and the new Ohio plant has completed its first large roof truss installation. As AI drives a surge in chip demand, these steps show Intel's long‑delayed capacity‑building plans are finally moving forward, though attracting enough external foundry customers remains critical for recouping the investment.

Intel wafer‑fab chief Naga Chandrasekaran said on Wednesday (the 21st) that Fab 62 near Phoenix is undergoing equipment installation and is slated to start operations in 2028. The nearby Fab 52 is already running and is expected to begin volume production of its most advanced 18A process chips by the end of 2025, primarily for Intel’s own processors.

Equipment installation is a key pre‑production phase for a fab and also the most costly, with a single machine potentially costing hundreds of millions of dollars. By contrast, the new Albany plant in Ohio is still in the structural construction stage, having just completed its first large truss, indicating the project is moving to the next phase.

When the Ohio plant was announced in 2022, it was originally scheduled to start shipping chips in 2025. Now the first building’s target completion has shifted to 2030, with a second building slated for 2031, pushing the timeline back by at least five years from the original plan.
In September, reports surfaced that SK Hynix (SKHY-US) might lease part of the Ohio facility to produce memory, but neither side confirmed the rumor, so no firm order can be assumed yet.

Since Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger took over in March 2025, he has been more cautious than his predecessor, Pat Sprague, about the massive expansion, emphasizing that new fabs will only proceed once sufficient demand is verified. The current forward movement reflects growing confidence in future capacity needs.

The most concrete driver right now comes from Intel’s own products. Orders for data‑center processors used in AI services have surged, and Intel is scrambling to keep up. In July the company raised its plant‑and‑equipment budget for the year to roughly $20 billion and expects a significant increase by 2027, still well below Wall Street’s estimate of about $60 billion for TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US).

External foundry business, however, remains unproven. Intel has yet to secure a major outside customer for its Arizona 18A process, and past delays with its 7nm and 10nm nodes have made customers hesitant to place new orders.

Nevertheless, TSMC’s advanced capacity is tightening, which could create an opening for Intel. Mizuho analyst Jordan Klein noted that major players such as Nvidia (NVDA-US), AMD (AMD‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) are fiercely competing for TSMC’s limited capacity.

TechInsights analyst Dan Hutcheson said customers are looking to build a second supply source to strengthen their bargaining position with TSMC. He added that several large companies are already testing Intel’s processes, but whether those tests will translate into volume production orders remains to be seen.

items.title: 黃仁勳GTC重點一次看 新晶片量產、AI工廠裝箱出貨、搶攻機器人
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's GTC Highlights: New Chip Mass Production, AI Factory Shipping, Robot Push
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳在柏林GTC大會表示，AI正開啟新一輪工業革命，企業不僅要使用AI，更應成為AI的生產者。他宣布Vera Rubin全面量產，並介紹模組化AI工廠、AI代理安全平台、自駕車與人形機器人布局，強調輝達已從GPU供應商，發展為提供完整AI工廠平台的企業。
黃仁勳指出，當新技術改變製造方式，以及人類能夠創造的事物，工業革命便會發生。AI如同電力，將影響各行各業，並催生新產業，目前仍處於初期階段。
AI如同電力 歐洲須建立自己的產業
他將AI產業比喻為「五層蛋糕」，由能源、運算、AI基礎設施、模型與應用組成。能源驅動電腦，電腦構成AI工廠，模型在工廠中產生token，再將數位智慧融入應用。因此，AI不只是軟體，也是一種持續生產智慧的製造業。
黃仁勳表示，輝達過去一年在歐洲投資近100億美元，涵蓋新創企業及合作計畫，並已建立超過1.2萬項合作關係。他強調，歐洲要建立AI經濟，關鍵在於汽車、製造、醫療與金融等產業全面採用AI，將既有專業轉化為競爭力。
Vera Rubin量產 系統整合推升效能
黃仁勳表示，輝達透過晶片、系統、軟體與演算法的協同設計，過去十年將AI效能提升100萬倍。隨著摩爾定律逼近極限，效能進步必須仰賴整套系統共同創新。
他宣布Vera Rubin已全面量產，採用全液冷及無纜線設計，運算節點組裝時間由Grace Blackwell的兩小時，縮短至不到五分鐘，改善製造效率與可靠性。NVLink則可將72個GPU連接為一套大型運算系統。
黃仁勳指出，新平台不只處理語言模型，也涵蓋AI代理的執行框架、資料處理及工具運算，支援代理從思考到完成工作的完整流程。
網路方面，輝達展示採用共同封裝光學（CPO）技術的Spectrum-X交換器，運用與台積電共同開發的COUPE製程，讓光學元件直接連接晶片。黃仁勳表示，產品已全面量產，具備512個連接埠，每埠傳輸速率為200 Gb/s。
AI工廠模組化 縮短部署與資金閒置
黃仁勳表示，一座1 GW的AI工廠造價約500億美元，涵蓋運算、網路、儲存、供電及冷卻等設備，僅有高效能晶片並不足夠，還必須整合整座工廠的設計與營運。
輝達DSX參考架構從數位孿生出發，在施工前模擬效能、電力、用水與散熱。據介紹，DSX Max-Q可動態調配電力，在相同產出下減少30%耗電量。
Vera Rubin的封閉式液冷系統可使用最高攝氏45度的冷卻液，在氣候適宜地區，透過室外乾式冷卻器散熱，減少蒸發用水。輝達表示，在2 GW規模下，每日可節省5,400萬公升水。
新推出的DSX Pod則將設備整合、布線及測試移至工廠完成，再以貨櫃運送。現場公用設施就緒後，部署時間預計可由數月縮短至數天；黃仁勳另估計，設備到貨至正式生產token的整體流程，可由四至五個月縮短至約一個月，降低閒置算力與資本支出的浪費。
AI代理帶動需求 安全不能只靠口頭要求
黃仁勳表示，AI代理能夠推理、反覆嘗試並使用工具，實用性提高的同時，也消耗更多token，進而帶動GPU需求成長。
他將AI代理拆解為模型、執行框架、安全沙箱、知識與工具五個部分。其中，安全是部署自主系統的前提，不能只是要求AI「不要刪除資料」或「不要碰金鑰」，而須透過工程機制限制權限。
輝達推出的OpenShell，能在系統呼叫、檔案存取及網路連線層級執行政策。代理在獨立沙箱內運作，對外連線須經外部監管元件檢查，金鑰也保留在沙箱外，避免代理直接持有。
另一項安全機制Sentry運行於BlueField 4，在與代理隔離的硬體環境中監控活動。依輝達介紹，若發現代理計畫執行非預期操作，可在毫秒內切斷其模型連線並隔離。黃仁勳也宣布，輝達正與Anthropic合作開發Claude OpenShell代理。
企業價值在知識與工具 軟體業將迎更多用戶
黃仁勳認為，企業未來將同時使用閉源模型及客製化開放模型，依任務選擇最適合的工具，單一模型無法包辦一切。
輝達持續提供Nemotron語言模型、Cosmos世界基礎模型等開放模型，讓企業利用自身資料進行後續訓練。他強調，讓AI代理具備專業能力的關鍵，是企業掌握的知識與工具。
例如，Lila Sciences利用BioNeMo及CUDA-X工具設計蛋白質與化合物，將虛擬實驗結果送交實體實驗室驗證；西門子利用AI代理規劃生產，再透過數位孿生檢驗；達梭系統則讓代理協助車門設計、模擬及修正，最後由工程師審查方案。
對於AI可能終結軟體與工具公司的說法，黃仁勳持相反看法。他認為，AI代理仍須依靠專業工具完成工作，將為工具帶來更多使用者，軟體公司也將提供擅長操作自家產品的代理服務。
實體AI接棒 自駕車與機器人擴大布局
黃仁勳將能理解物理世界並採取行動的「實體AI」，視為下一波浪潮，應用不僅包括機器人，也涵蓋電信基地台及自適應放射治療。
他表示，輝達與諾基亞經過近八年努力，已在T-Mobile網路完成首次商業通話，後續可在既有運算架構上加入AI，提升頻譜效率，並讓電信設施逐步成為分散式AI基礎設施。
自駕車方面，輝達透過Hyperion參考架構，整合攝影機、雷達、光達及運算系統，讓車商與自駕軟體業者共同開發，並串接叫車平台。黃仁勳宣布，福斯商旅、捷豹路虎、Volvo及賓士的新車型將加入相關布局。
在人形機器人領域，他認為標準化外型有助擴大產量，形成持續改良的循環。若機器人能透過示範快速學習，中小企業便不必建立完整研發團隊，也能導入應用。
輝達並與思靈機器人合作推出Agile One參考機器人，預計於演講所指的明年第一季上市，預先整合電腦與軟體，縮短開發時間。
個人電腦轉型 成為能執行任務的助手
黃仁勳表示，個人電腦將逐步成為個人AI助手，除了模型，也須具備執行框架、安全環境，以及存取知識與工具的能力。
他介紹輝達與微軟合作四年打造的RTX Spark系列，採用N1X晶片，涵蓋桌機、筆電與工作站，提供1 PFLOPS算力及128 GB記憶體；搭載Windows的DGX Station則提供20 PFLOPS算力與754 GB記憶體，預計於演講所指的年底上市。
演講最後，輝達展示利用RTX Spark建立機器人訓練場景，結合雲端平行訓練，再將驗證後的策略部署到實體機器人。
黃仁勳藉此說明，AI代理與實體AI正逐步串接，讓個人電腦從操作工具，走向協助使用者規劃、設計並完成工作的夥伴。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said at the Berlin GTC that AI is launching a new industrial revolution; companies should not only use AI but become AI producers. He announced full‑scale production of Vera Rubin and introduced a modular AI factory, an AI‑agent security platform, and plans for autonomous vehicles and humanoid robots, stressing that Nvidia has evolved from a GPU supplier to a provider of a complete AI‑factory platform.

Huang noted that an industrial revolution occurs when new technology changes how things are manufactured and what humans can create. AI, like electricity, will affect every industry and spawn new sectors, and we are still in the early stage.
AI is like electricity – Europe must build its own industry

He likened the AI industry to a five‑layer cake made of energy, compute, AI infrastructure, models and applications. Energy powers computers, computers form the AI factory, models generate tokens inside the factory, and digital intelligence is infused into applications. Thus AI is not just software but a manufacturing process that continuously produces intelligence.

Huang said Nvidia has invested nearly $10 billion in Europe over the past year across startups and partnership programs and has established more than 12,000 collaborations. He emphasized that Europe’s AI economy depends on automotive, manufacturing, healthcare and finance fully adopting AI, turning existing expertise into competitive advantage.
Vera Rubin mass production boosts system integration performance

Huang explained that by co‑designing chips, systems, software and algorithms, Nvidia has increased AI performance a million‑fold over the past decade. As Moore’s Law nears its limits, further gains must come from system‑wide innovation.

He announced that Vera Rubin is now in full production, featuring full‑liquid cooling and a cable‑free design. Assembly time for a compute node has dropped from two hours (Grace Blackwell) to under five minutes, improving manufacturing efficiency and reliability. NVLink can connect 72 GPUs into a single large compute system.

Huang said the new platform handles not only language models but also the execution framework for AI agents, data processing and tool compute, supporting an agent’s end‑to‑end workflow from reasoning to task completion.

On the networking side, Nvidia showcased the Spectrum‑X switch built with co‑packaged optics (CPO) using the COUPE process co‑developed with TSMC, which directly attaches optical components to the chip. Huang said the product is now in full production, offering 512 ports at 200 Gb/s each.
Modular AI factory shortens deployment and idle capital

Huang stated that a 1 GW AI factory costs about $50 billion and includes compute, networking, storage, power and cooling equipment. High‑performance chips alone are insufficient; the entire factory’s design and operation must be integrated.

Nvidia’s DSX reference architecture starts from a digital twin to simulate performance, power, water use and heat before construction. DSX Max‑Q can dynamically allocate power, cutting energy use by 30% for the same output.

Vera Rubin’s closed‑loop liquid‑cooling system can use coolant up to 45 °C; in suitable climates it can be cooled by outdoor dry coolers, reducing evaporative water use. Nvidia said a 2 GW deployment can save 54 million liters of water per day.

The new DSX Pod integrates equipment, wiring and testing at the factory and ships it in containers. Once site utilities are ready, deployment time can shrink from months to days; Huang estimates the whole process from equipment arrival to production tokens can drop from four‑to‑five months to about one month, reducing idle compute and capital waste.
AI agents drive demand; safety can’t rely on verbal rules alone
Huang said AI agents can reason, iterate and use tools, increasing usefulness but also consuming more tokens, which in turn drives GPU demand growth.

He broke AI agents into five components: model, execution framework, security sandbox, knowledge and tools. Security is a prerequisite for deploying autonomous systems and cannot rely merely on telling the AI “don’t delete data” or “don’t touch keys”; it must be enforced through engineering controls that limit permissions.

Nvidia’s OpenShell can enforce policies at the system‑call, file‑access and network‑connection layers. Agents run inside isolated sandboxes; external connections must pass through a supervisory component, and keys remain outside the sandbox to prevent agents from holding them directly.

Another security mechanism, Sentry, runs on BlueField 4 and monitors activity in a hardware‑isolated environment separate from the agent. Nvidia says if an agent attempts an unexpected operation, Sentry can cut its model connection and isolate it within milliseconds. Huang also announced Nvidia’s collaboration with Anthropic to develop a Claude OpenShell agent.
Enterprise value lies in knowledge and tools; software firms will see more users
Huang believes enterprises will use both closed‑source models and custom open models, selecting the best tool for each task; no single model can do everything.

Nvidia continues to offer open models such as Nemotron and the Cosmos world model, enabling companies to fine‑tune them with their own data. He stressed that giving AI agents professional capability hinges on the knowledge and tools that enterprises possess.

For example, Lila Sciences uses BioNeMo and CUDA‑X tools to design proteins and compounds, sending virtual experiment results to physical labs for validation; Siemens uses AI agents to plan production and then verifies via digital twins; Dassault Systemes lets agents assist with door design, simulation and revision, with engineers reviewing the final proposals.

When asked whether AI could end software and tool companies, Huang disagreed. He said AI agents still need specialized tools to get work done, which will bring more users to those tools, and software firms will also provide agents that are experts at using their own products.
Physical AI takes the baton: autonomous‑vehicle and robot expansion
Huang described “physical AI” – AI that can understand the physical world and act in it – as the next wave, covering robots, telecom base stations and adaptive radiation therapy.

He noted that after nearly eight years of work with Nokia, Nvidia completed its first commercial call on T‑Mobile’s network; AI can later be added to the existing compute stack to improve spectrum efficiency and turn telecom infrastructure into distributed AI nodes.

In autonomous vehicles, Nvidia’s Hyperion reference architecture integrates cameras, radar, lidar and compute, enabling car makers and self‑driving software firms to co‑develop and connect to ride‑hailing platforms. Huang announced that new models from Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, Jaguar Land Rover, Volvo and Mercedes‑Benz will incorporate these capabilities.

In humanoid robotics, he said standardizing form factors helps scale production and creates a virtuous improvement cycle. If robots can learn quickly from demonstrations, small and medium enterprises won’t need full R&D teams to adopt them.

Nvidia, together with Agility Robotics, is launching the Agile One reference robot, slated for release in the first quarter of next year, with integrated compute and software to shorten development time.
Personal computers are transforming into task‑executing assistants
Huang said personal PCs will gradually become personal AI assistants; beyond models they must have execution frameworks, secure environments, and access to knowledge and tools.

He introduced the RTX Spark series, a four‑year Nvidia‑Microsoft collaboration built on the N1X chip, covering desktops, laptops and workstations, delivering 1 PFLOPS of compute and 128 GB of memory; the DGX Station running Windows offers 20 PFLOPS and 754 GB of memory and is expected to ship by year‑end.
At the close of his talk, Nvidia demonstrated building a robot training scenario with RTX Spark, combining cloud‑based parallel training and then deploying the validated policy to a physical robot.
Huang used this to illustrate that AI agents and physical AI are increasingly linked, turning personal computers from mere tool operators into partners that help users plan, design and complete work.

items.title: 〈台股開盤〉外資翻多激勵大盤開高漲逾400點 CCL、PCB強勢噴出
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Opens Higher as Foreign Investors Turn Net Buyers, Boosting Index Over 400 Points; CCL and PCB Sectors Surge
paras: 台北股市今(22)日早盤在外資在期貨及現貨同步翻多同時，由電子股帶動之下出現強勢反彈，台積電(2330-TW)以2435元開高 ，上漲0.62%，電子類股勁揚1%，並占大盤成交比重達 8%，資深證券分析師指出，台股在站上 5 日線後，後續的量能如能續增，將成有利多方反攻的格局形成。
在亞洲區域股市方面，日本日經及南韓股市早盤下跌，資深證券分析師簡伯儀指出，在美股包括Space X、Meta及美超微等企業已公布財報業績表現及展望佳之下，有利後續台股的醞釀再強攻格局。
台股集中市場加權股價指數22日以46942.75點開出，盤早一度上漲超過400點，爲台股連續下跌後的反彈，不過，集中市場盤面仍呈現量能仍待放大，預估今天全場成交值量僅約8860億元。
至昨日仍為外資重要提款對象的權王台積電，早盤一度上漲0.62%達2435元，鴻海(2317-TW)下跌、台達電(2308-TW)及聯發科(2454-TW)股價同步上漲。IC載板股方面，欣興(3037-TW)、南電(8046-TW)及景碩(3189-TW)全數上漲。
CCL類股台光電(2383-TW)漲停、聯茂(6213-TW)股價走高，其中聯茂股價早盤885元並創新天價。
台北股市昨日在電子股帶動之下出現強勢反彈，最後一盤交易爆發585億元鉅量，拉抬指數上漲160.56點，終場大盤收在46887.77點，上漲594.84點，成交值8331.91億元，並站上5日線，外資也中止對台股的連續10個交易日合計8380.64億元賣超，轉爲買超9.6億元。
外資昨天集中市場主要買超的標的，包括友達(2409-TW)、鴻海(及南亞(1303-TW)都超過2萬張。在期貨市場上 ，外資今天交易口數淨額爲多單1062口，未平倉淨額爲空單86072口。

統一證券指出，包括SpaceX、美超微與Meta強勁財報消弭市場對AI泡沫的悲觀情緒；輝達於柏林GTC大會再度點名多檔台灣供應鏈，強調AI創造新工業革命才剛開始，Rubin放量將創造更大算力供給。籌碼面，外資終結連續10個交易日合計賣超逾8,300億元的調節壓力，轉為小幅買超22億元，台股可望緩步挑戰10日線及月線。惟中東地緣局勢仍干擾能源市場，預期大盤震盪盤堅。建議保持適度資金彈性，避免過度槓桿，逢回布局，AI概念及業績題材股，搭配短期營收動能股，長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進封測、半導體設備、PCB供應鏈、光傳輸、散熱、連接器、貨櫃散裝、塑化及特用化學等。
台股的操作建議上，國票證券建議，隨TPCA展會揭示高階PCB與CCL材料升級趨勢，AI伺服器、高速光通訊及低軌衛星需求持續擴大，有利具備高階HDI製程、低損耗材料及供應鏈整合能力的業者提升競爭優勢，展望2027年，隨新一代AI平台導入及高階產品逐步放量，相關業者營運動能可望延續，操作上可留意高階PCB相關族群，若後續股價適度回檔，可伺機布局。
同時，輝達德國柏林GTC於昨日登場，輝達超大規模與高效能運算副總裁Ian Buck(伊恩·巴克)在展前記者會上宣布在歐洲建立主權AI工廠，合作夥伴為法國的BULL(布爾電腦)以及鴻海集團的捷克廠。此外，輝達更直接點名四大供應鏈未來將大舉擴產以配合這波AI基建，台系廠商包括欣興、京元電(2449-TW)、矽品都入列。
而市場AI 及儲能需求仍然強勁，繼電器廠松川精密 (7788-TW) 營運處於上升的軌道中，松川精密董事會21日決議，擬以15億元上限發行無擔保可轉換公司債(CB)進行籌資，這也是松川在2025年10月16日上市掛牌以來首度的市場籌資動作，主辦券商爲元大證券。
松川精密營運大幅成長中，松川精密2026年1-9月營收68.52億元，已超越2025年全年營收總和，年增幅達44%。公司並指出，此一市場籌資用途償還銀行借款及充實營運資金。
今晨收盤的美股表現佳，且全面收高，SpaceX 強勁財報與潛在合併特斯拉的消息，帶動資金回流科技股，緩解市場對人工智慧 (AI) 投資回報的疑慮。那斯達克指數上漲逾 1%，標普 500 指數連續第 3 個交易日收紅，道瓊則勁揚約 360 點。

美股收盤道瓊工業指數上漲 360.21 點，或 0.69%，報 52,856.09 點。那斯達克指數上漲 278.04 點，或 1.05%，報 26,702.86 點。S&P 500 指數上漲 44.60 點，或 0.58%，報 7,757.17 點。費城半導體指數上漲 221.74 點，或 1.97%，報 11,505.56 點。在台股指標方面，輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.54%；台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上揚 1.60%
paras_en: Taipei's stock market opened this morning (22nd) with foreign investors turning net buyers in both futures and spot markets, sparking a strong rebound led by electronics stocks. TSMC (2330-TW) opened at NT$2,435, up 0.62%, while the electronics sector jumped 1% and accounted for 8% of total market turnover. A senior securities analyst noted that once the market stays above its 5‑day moving average, continued volume growth could create a favorable environment for a bullish counter‑attack.

In Asian markets, Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI fell in early trading. Senior analyst Jian Boyi said that strong earnings reports and outlooks from U.S. companies such as SpaceX, Meta and AMD provide a tailwind for a renewed aggressive push in Taiwan equities.

The Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Index opened at 46,942.75 points on the 22nd, briefly climbing more than 400 points in early trading – a rebound after a series of declines. However, overall market volume remains modest, with total turnover estimated at about NT$886 billion for the day.

TSMC, still a key target for foreign investors, rose 0.62% to NT$2,435 in early trading. Hon Hai (2317‑TW) fell, while Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and MediaTek (2454‑TW) rose. All IC substrate stocks – Unimicron (3037‑TW), Nan Ya (8046‑TW) and Kinsus (3189‑TW) – posted gains.
CCL‑related stocks saw strong moves: Taiwan Optoelectronics (2383‑TW) hit its daily limit up, and Lianmao (6213‑TW) rose, trading at NT$885 in early trading, a new intraday high.

Yesterday, the market rallied sharply on the back of electronics stocks, with a massive NT$58.5 billion surge in the final session that lifted the index by 160.56 points. The session closed at 46,887.77 points, up 594.84 points, with turnover of NT$833.191 billion, and the index stayed above its 5‑day average. Foreign investors also reversed a ten‑day cumulative net sell of NT$8,380.64 billion into a net buy of NT$960 million.

Foreign investors’ biggest net‑buy targets in the main market yesterday included AU Optronics (2409‑TW), Hon Hai and Nanya (1303‑TW), each exceeding 20,000 lots. In the futures market, foreign investors posted a net long of 1,062 contracts today, with open‑interest net short at 86,072 contracts.

Unified Securities highlighted that strong earnings from SpaceX, AMD and Meta have eased pessimism about an AI bubble; NVIDIA reiterated at the Berlin GTC that multiple Taiwanese suppliers are critical as AI drives a new industrial revolution, and Rubin’s capacity expansion will boost computing power. On the chip‑holding side, foreign investors ended a ten‑day cumulative net sell of over NT$830 billion, turning to a modest net buy of NT$2.2 billion, allowing the market to gradually test the 10‑day and monthly averages. However, Middle‑East geopolitical tensions continue to disturb energy markets, so the index is expected to trade sideways. The recommendation is to keep capital flexible, avoid excessive leverage, and re‑enter on pullbacks, focusing on AI‑related concepts, earnings‑driven stocks, short‑term revenue‑momentum names, and long‑term themes such as TSMC, advanced packaging, semiconductor equipment, PCB supply chains, optical transmission, thermal solutions, connectors, bulk cargo, plastics and specialty chemicals.

For trading ideas, Guo Piao Securities advises that the TPCA exhibition has highlighted an upgrade trend for high‑end PCB and CCL materials. Growing demand for AI servers, high‑speed optical communications and low‑Earth‑orbit satellites benefits companies with advanced HDI processes, low‑loss materials and integrated supply chains, enhancing their competitive edge. Looking to 2027, as next‑generation AI platforms roll out and high‑end products scale, operating momentum for these firms should continue. Investors may watch high‑end PCB groups and consider buying on modest pullbacks.

NVIDIA’s Berlin GTC took place yesterday, where NVIDIA’s senior VP of high‑performance computing Ian Buck announced plans to build a sovereign AI factory in Europe, partnering with France’s BULL and Hon Hai’s Czech plant. NVIDIA also singled out four Taiwanese suppliers – Unimicron, Jingyuan Electronics (2449‑TW), Siliconware Precision Industries and others – that will expand capacity to meet the AI infrastructure wave.

AI and energy‑storage demand remain strong. Relay manufacturer Song Chuan Precision (7788‑TW) is on an upward trajectory; its board resolved on the 21st to raise up to NT$1.5 billion via unsecured convertible bonds, the company’s first market‑raising effort since its IPO on 16 Oct 2025, with Yuanta Securities as lead underwriter.

Song Chuan’s operations are growing rapidly, with revenue of NT$6.852 billion for Jan‑Sep 2026, already surpassing its full‑year 2025 revenue and representing a 44% year‑over‑year increase. The proceeds from the bond issuance will be used to repay bank loans and bolster working capital.

U.S. markets closed strongly across the board this morning. A robust SpaceX earnings report and speculation about a potential Tesla merger drove capital back into tech stocks, easing concerns over AI investment returns. The Nasdaq rose more than 1%, the S&P 500 posted its third consecutive red‑day close, and the Dow jumped about 360 points.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed up 360.21 points, or 0.69%, at 52,856.09. The Nasdaq gained 278.04 points, or 1.05%, at 26,702.86. The S&P 500 rose 44.60 points, or 0.58%, at 7,757.17. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index climbed 221.74 points, or 1.97%, to 11,505.56. In Taiwan, NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) was up 2.54% and TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose 1.60%.

items.title: Meta祭新股留住祖克柏！加州富人稅恐逼他繳數十億美元 八年不得離開總部所在地
items.title_en: Meta Offers New Shares to Keep Zuckerberg; California Wealth Tax Could Force Him to Pay Tens of Billions, Must Stay at Headquarters for Eight Years
paras: Meta Platforms(META-US)周三(21日)表示，已與執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)簽署協議，確保他未來八年仍居住於公司總部所在的加州，不會因加州富人稅提案正式立法而離開。祖克柏為全球第五大富豪，目前身價達2470億美元。
祖克柏為全球第五大富豪，目前身價達2470億美元。他並不支持加州第40號提案(Proposition 40)，也就是俗稱的「加州富人稅」，並於周三稍早表示，若加州通過此提案，他考慮離開加州。加州選民將於下個月對這項公投提案作出決定。
根據Meta文件，該公司已透過提出新的股票計畫，成功說服祖克柏繼續留在加州。根據文件內容，祖克柏承諾未來八年內「持續居住於加州，或公司設有企業總部的其他司法管轄區」。
Meta指出，祖克柏考慮離開加州，是因為該州提出的富人稅可能使他面臨數十億美元的稅款，甚至迫使他出售具有投票權的股票來繳稅。
因此Meta表示，2027年1月新發行無投票權的C類普通股，部分目的就是避免這種情況發生。
祖克柏將取得不具投票權的C類股票，可在出售股票換取流動資金的同時，不必削弱自己對公司的投票控制權。作為交換，只要他繼續擔任全職領導職務，就承諾居住在加州，或Meta總部所在地。
根據協議，祖克柏可立即出售所獲C類股票的20%，相當於他整體經濟持股的10%。這將提供流動資金，協助他支付可能產生的稅款。其餘80%的C類股票最初受到出售限制，但只要祖克柏持續領導公司，相關限制就會在八年內逐步解除。
第40號提案由醫療照護工作者工會及加州進步派政治人物推動，包括聯邦眾議員Ro Khanna。這項稅收將影響2026年1月1日淨資產超過10億美元的人士，包括Google(GOOGL-US)共同創辦人布林(Sergey Brin)在內的部分全球富豪反對這項稅制，並已離開加州。近期民調顯示，這項提案的支持與反對陣營競爭激烈。
Meta特別委員會表示，讓祖克柏繼續在公司總部所在地工作「至關重要」，尤其是在人工智慧(AI)競賽日益激烈之際，祖克柏正與Meta超級智慧實驗室(Meta Superintelligence Labs)密切合作。
特別委員會也提到Covid-19情期間公司面臨的「困難」。當時祖克柏曾離開管理團隊所在之處，委員會不希望公司再次面臨類似挑戰。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) said on Wednesday (the 21st) that it has signed an agreement with CEO Mark Zuckerberg to ensure he will continue to reside in California, where the company’s headquarters are located, for the next eight years and will not leave even if the California wealth‑tax proposal becomes law. Zuckerberg is the world’s fifth‑richest person, with a net worth of $247 billion.

Zuckerberg, the world’s fifth‑richest person with a net worth of $247 billion, does not support California Proposition 40, commonly called the “California wealth tax,” and earlier on Wednesday said that if the state passes the measure he would consider leaving California. Voters will decide on the referendum next month.

According to Meta documents, the company has persuaded Zuckerberg to stay in California by introducing a new stock plan. The filing states that Zuckerberg has committed to continue living in California, or any other jurisdiction where the company has its corporate headquarters, for the next eight years.

Meta noted that Zuckerberg’s consideration of leaving California stems from the state’s proposed wealth tax, which could expose him to tens of billions of dollars in taxes and might even force him to sell voting‑share stock to pay the levy.
Therefore, Meta said that the non‑voting Class C common shares to be issued in January 2027 are partly intended to prevent that scenario.

Zuckerberg will receive non‑voting Class C shares, allowing him to raise cash by selling stock without diluting his voting control of the company. In exchange, he must remain in a full‑time leadership role and commit to residing in California or at Meta’s headquarters.

Under the agreement, Zuckerberg can immediately sell 20% of the Class C shares he receives, equivalent to 10% of his total economic stake, providing liquidity to help cover any potential tax bill. The remaining 80% of the Class C shares are initially subject to a sell‑restriction, which will be lifted gradually over eight years as long as he continues to lead the company.

Proposition 40 is backed by health‑care worker unions and progressive California politicians, including U.S. Representative Ro Khanna. The tax would affect anyone with net assets over $1 billion as of Jan 1 2026, and some global billionaires such as Google co‑founder Sergey Brin have opposed the measure and already left the state. Recent polls show a fierce battle between supporters and opponents.
Meta’s special committee said keeping Zuckerberg at the company’s headquarters is “critical,” especially as the AI race intensifies, with Zuckerberg working closely with Meta Superintelligence Labs.

The committee also referenced the “difficulties” the company faced during the Covid‑19 period, when Zuckerberg stepped away from the management team’s location, and said it does not want the firm to encounter a similar challenge again.

items.title: 一文掌握特斯拉財報會議：2030拚年產500萬輛電動車、Optimus明年底商業化、未透露合併猜測
items.title_en: Tesla Earnings Call in One Article: Targeting 5 Million EVs by 2030, Optimus Commercialization Next Year, No Comment on Merger Rumors
paras: 馬斯克週三（21日）表示，特斯拉(TSLA-US)目標是到2030年前後實現年產約500萬輛電動車。財務長透露，資料中心對Megapack的需求「極其強勁」，馬斯克補充，2027年的Megapack產能已幾乎售罄。針對外界對與SpaceX潛在合併的猜測，馬斯克明確表示，不會就此透露更多資訊。
特斯拉將年度資本支出目標從逾250億美元下調至200億美元，同時馬斯克為投資人描繪了一幅跨越多個業務領域的長期成長藍圖，涵蓋電動車產能、儲能業務及人形機器人的進展。
特斯拉週三公布，截至9月的2026年第三季營收為280.5億美元，年增率幾乎為零，略低於分析師預期的281.3億美元；但調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為0.48美元，較分析師預期高約9%。
特斯拉將年度資本支出目標由此前的逾250億美元下調至200億美元，降幅約20%。公司同時坦承，電池供應有限正在拖累現有生產，並表示正推進擴大供應規模的相關工作，以提升整體電池產能。
馬斯克在電話會議上表示，特斯拉的目標是到2030年前後實現年產約500萬輛電動車。他強調，FSD（完全自動駕駛）是目前帶動需求的最核心因素，「市場上目前沒有任何一款可購買的電動車能與FSD競爭」，需求成長速度已明顯超過生產能力。
在儲能業務方面，公司財務長透露，資料中心對巨型電池Megapack的需求「極其強勁」，馬斯克補充，2027年的Megapack產能已幾乎售罄。
人形機器人方面，特斯拉已在美國加州佛蒙特工廠的高產量生產線上啟動Optimus的「早期產品」生產。馬斯克表示，預計到2027年底將解決目前Optimus面臨的技術及生產問題。
針對外界對特斯拉與SpaceX潛在合併的猜測，馬斯克在電話會議上明確表示，不會就此透露更多資訊。

交車受限於產能 儲能接近「售罄」

第三季，特斯拉連續兩季交車量超過48萬輛。財務長Vaibhav Taneja指出，公司目前的訂單積壓量達到四年來最高水準，「交車主要受限於生產」。
在華爾街最關注的毛利率方面，特斯拉表現亮眼。排除碳排放積分(碳權)收入後，電動車業務毛利率從第二季的16.3%升至18.1%；儲能業務創下13.7GWh史上第二高部署量，毛利率從20.4%躍升至33.1%；包含超級充電服務和保險在內的服務業務，毛利率也達到15.9%歷史新高。
馬斯克對儲能業務的未來充滿信心。他表示：「能源需求非常強勁。實際上，我們2027年的所有Megapack幾乎已經售罄，我們正盡可能加快提升產能，以滿足需求。」
馬斯克預期，後續毛利率將進一步改善。
現金流方面，特斯拉第三季末的自由現金流超過1.5億美元，現金及投資餘額超過450億美元。公司將本年度資本支出指引調整為約200億美元，並取得300億美元的借款額度，以支持未來的大規模擴張。

FSD與Robotaxi

自動駕駛（FSD）已成為推動特斯拉電動車銷售的最大動力。數據顯示，第三季北美地區超過75%的交車輛在交車時訂閱了FSD，較第二季高出約20個百分點。全球FSD付費用戶超過170萬，其中50%為訂閱用戶。
Vaibhav Taneja透露，第三季累計無人監督自動駕駛里程較前一季成長8倍，整個季度每週都維持雙位數成長。 Vaibhav Taneja直言：「如果你還沒試過FSD，我每次都要說，只要你試過，就再也無法回去開其他任何一款電動車。」
分析師Pierre Ferragu在會議上指出，若以每輛電動車約7,000美元的毛利估算，FSD訂閱收入對電動車銷售當季的影響有限；但若以每年逾1,000美元的訂閱費計算，整個產品生命週期內，FSD可能使單車利潤至少翻倍。他並估計，FSD年度經常性收入(ARR)已接近10億美元。
Vaibhav Taneja對此表示認同，並承諾隨著業務規模擴大，將公布更多FSD相關指標，包括收入及客戶留存率。
在Robotaxi方面，德州奧斯汀的Cybercab車隊規模，自一個月前發布以來已成長10倍。 馬斯克在描述里程成長時，使用了極具衝擊力的比喻：「當我看著每週的圖表時，哇，那基本上就像火箭進入軌道一樣，成長得非常快。」
在擴張路徑上，Ashok Elluswamy透露，Robotaxi服務將於下月進軍達拉斯市場，目前已涵蓋六座城市，並計畫在年底前實現24小時全天候營運、拓展至高速公路路段及更多氣候條件。
他同時表示，目前的擴張主要受到AI能力進展的推動，預計到明年第一、第二季，限制因素將逐漸轉為監管審批。
在獲利路徑方面，Vaibhav Taneja表示，Robotaxi業務目前尚未達到每英里0.30美元的目標成本，但實現目標的路徑已相當明確。馬斯克預計，該業務將從明年第二季起開始「引起關注」，並在明年第三、第四季成為「重要貢獻」。
工程副總裁Lars Moravy透露，目前生產的Cybercab全部用於內部車隊，但「我們正努力在今年年底前將Cybercab交付給客戶」。
Lars Moravy表示，Cybercab生產線的實際產能遠高於目前公布的年產12.5萬輛數字。目前的生產節奏由Robotaxi服務的車輛需求決定，雙方正在「競賽」：服務端的指數型里程成長，與生產線的產能提升速度相互追趕。

Optimus機器人

人形機器人Optimus被特斯拉視為下一個可能實現爆發式成長的產品。馬斯克將Optimus人形機器人大規模交付外部客戶的時間，定在「大約一年後」，也就是2027年底前後。他強調，這個時間點取決於三大里程碑能否到位：電機設計定型、AI軟體成熟，以及AI5晶片整合。
馬斯克透露，目前已在加州佛蒙特工廠的「百萬台級高產量生產線」上開始早期生產，同時也在奧斯汀興建新廠房，以支撐更大的產能。
然而，馬斯克坦言，由於產品設計仍在持續改良，預計至少需要一年時間，才能達到每週20,000台的年化產能。
在技術細節方面，馬斯克和Ashok Elluswamy都將手部設計列為目前最主要的機電工程難題。人類手指具備自我修復能力，兼顧柔軟觸感與多維度感測功能；機器人手部則面臨如何同時實現耐磨性與靈活性的重大挑戰。
預計明年4月整合的AI5晶片，運算能力將較AI4提升約10倍，進而顯著增強Optimus處理複雜任務的能力。
在機器人訓練方面，特斯拉並未採用電動車的「群眾外包」模式，而是建立「Optimus學院」，讓機器人透過數以萬計次的自我對弈(Self-play)進行學習。 馬斯克生動比喻道：「你有了一個蹣跚學步的孩子，一開始他們跌跌撞撞……最終他們學會了自己擦屁股，這是一個重大的里程碑。任何有孩子的人都知道。」
馬斯克提出Optimus幾個關鍵時間點：

約1至2個月內，將發布一段非預先編程(Unscripted)的機器人工作影片，以證明其實際AI能力。
如果一切順利，預計明年4月將特斯拉AI5晶片整合至Optimus，運算能力將提升一個數量級。
預計明年底左右，將Optimus交付給特斯拉以外的公司，首批高價值應用場景將是全天候運作的重工業，以及危險、重複性的工作。


馬斯克表示，「我依然堅信，Optimus將成為地球上最偉大的產品。總體而言，人形機器人也將成為地球上最偉大的產品。」

Terafab晶片工廠

為了徹底解決半導體運算能力與供應鏈瓶頸，特斯拉正在德州奧斯汀快速推進自研晶片製造基地Terafab。
馬斯克表示，按照計畫，該工廠將於明年上半年開始設備調試，力爭明年5、6月產出首片測試晶片，並希望在2028年第三季實現具實用價值的晶片量產。
這不僅是一項技術工程，也需要龐大的資金投入。馬斯克透露：「在2028年初之前，資本設備投入肯定會達到數百億美元。而長期來看，投入金額將遠超1,000億美元。」
馬斯克將Terafab定位為Optimus大規模擴張的「必要資產」，認為解決記憶體、封裝及邏輯晶片等半導體瓶頸，是支撐機器人產業化的關鍵前提。他認為，這筆投資絕對值得，「正如我在X上公開說過的，我認為Terafab將成為世界上最有價值的建築，其經濟價值可能使其躋身全球前20大國家之列。」
paras_en: Elon Musk said on Wednesday (the 21st) that Tesla (TSLA-US) aims to produce about 5 million electric vehicles per year around 2030. The CFO disclosed that demand for Megapack from data centers is "extremely strong," and Musk added that Megapack capacity for 2027 is almost fully sold. Regarding speculation about a possible merger with SpaceX, Musk made it clear he will not provide any further information.

Tesla lowered its annual capital‑expenditure target from over $25 billion to $20 billion, while Musk painted a long‑term growth roadmap spanning multiple business areas, including EV capacity, energy storage and humanoid robots.

Tesla reported on Wednesday that third‑quarter 2026 revenue through September was $28.05 billion, essentially flat year‑over‑year and slightly below analysts' estimate of $28.13 billion; adjusted earnings per share were $0.48, about 9% above expectations.

The company cut its annual cap‑ex goal from more than $25 billion to $20 billion, a roughly 20% reduction. It also admitted that limited battery supply is dragging on current production and said it is working to expand supply to boost overall battery capacity.

In the earnings call Musk reiterated the goal of roughly 5 million EVs per year around 2030. He emphasized that Full Self‑Driving (FSD) is the core demand driver, stating "no purchasable EV on the market can compete with FSD" and that demand growth is already outpacing production capability.
Regarding energy storage, the CFO said data‑center demand for the giant Megapack battery is "extremely strong," and Musk added that Megapack capacity for 2027 is virtually sold out.

On humanoid robots, Tesla has started early‑product production of Optimus on a high‑volume line at its Fremont, California factory. Musk said the technical and manufacturing issues facing Optimus are expected to be resolved by the end of 2027.
Addressing merger rumors with SpaceX, Musk said in the call he will not disclose any more information on the topic.

Vehicle deliveries are constrained by capacity while storage is nearing "sell‑out". In the third quarter Tesla delivered over 480,000 vehicles for the second consecutive quarter. CFO Vaibhav Taneja noted that order backlog is at a four‑year high, with deliveries mainly limited by production.

On the margin metric Wall Street watches most, Tesla shone. Excluding carbon‑credit revenue, EV gross margin rose from 16.3% in Q2 to 18.1%; energy‑storage gross margin jumped from 20.4% to 33.1% on a record‑second‑highest deployment of 13.7 GWh; and services—including Supercharging and insurance—reached a historic 15.9% gross margin.

Musk expressed confidence in the storage business, saying "energy demand is very strong. In fact, virtually all Megapack units for 2027 are already sold, and we are accelerating capacity expansion to meet that demand."
Musk expects margins to improve further going forward.

Cash flow: free cash flow at the end of Q3 exceeded $150 million and cash and investments topped $45 billion. The company revised its cap‑ex guidance to about $20 billion for the year and secured a $30 billion loan facility to fund large‑scale expansion.

FSD and Robotaxi: Autonomous driving (FSD) is now the biggest driver of Tesla EV sales. Data show that over 75% of North‑American deliveries in Q3 subscribed to FSD at delivery, about 20 percentage points higher than Q2. Global paid FSD users exceed 1.7 million, half of whom are subscribers.

CFO Vaibhav Taneja said total unsupervised autonomous‑driving miles in Q3 grew eight‑fold versus the prior quarter, with double‑digit weekly growth throughout the quarter. He added, "If you haven't tried FSD, I have to say every time you do, you can never go back to any other EV."

Analyst Pierre Ferragu noted that assuming roughly $7,000 gross profit per vehicle, FSD subscription revenue has limited impact on quarterly EV sales, but at over $1,000 annual subscription per car, FSD could double vehicle profit over its lifecycle. He estimated FSD annual recurring revenue is approaching $1 billion.
Taneja agreed and pledged to release more FSD metrics—including revenue and retention—as the business scales.
On Robotaxi, the Cybercab fleet in Austin, Texas has grown tenfold since its launch a month ago. Musk likened the mileage growth to "a rocket reaching orbit" when looking at the weekly charts.

Ashok Elluswamy said the Robotaxi service will enter the Dallas market next month, now covering six cities, with plans for 24‑hour operation, highway routes and broader climate conditions by year‑end.
He added that the expansion is currently driven by AI progress, with regulatory approvals expected to become the main constraint in Q1‑Q2 of next year.

Taneja said Robotaxi has not yet hit the target cost of $0.30 per mile, but the path to that goal is clear. Musk expects the business to start "gaining attention" in Q2 next year and become a "significant contributor" in Q3‑Q4.
VP of Engineering Lars Moravy disclosed that all Cybercabs produced so far are for internal use, but the team aims to deliver them to customers by the end of the year.

Moravy said the actual capacity of the Cybercab line far exceeds the publicly stated annual output of 125,000 units. Production pace is set by Robotaxi demand, creating a race between exponential mileage growth and line capacity expansion.

Optimus robots: Tesla sees the humanoid Optimus as a product with explosive growth potential. Musk set the timeline for large‑scale delivery to external customers at "about a year later," i.e., around the end of 2027, contingent on three milestones: motor design finalization, mature AI software, and AI‑5 chip integration.
He revealed early‑stage production has begun on a "million‑unit‑scale high‑volume" line at the Fremont plant, and a new factory is being built in Austin to support larger capacity.
However, Musk admitted the design is still being refined and will need at least a year to reach an annualized capacity of 20,000 units per week.

Both Musk and Elluswamy said hand design is the biggest electromechanical challenge; human hands self‑repair, combine softness and multi‑dimensional sensing, while robot hands must balance wear resistance with flexibility.
The AI‑5 chip slated for integration in April next year will deliver roughly ten times the compute of AI‑4, markedly boosting Optimus' ability to handle complex tasks.

For robot training, Tesla is not using the EV "crowd‑sourced" model but has created an "Optimus Academy" where robots learn via tens of thousands of self‑play games. Musk analogized, "It's like a toddler learning to walk—lots of falls at first, then they learn to wipe themselves; that's a huge milestone anyone with kids understands."

Musk outlined several key Optimus milestones: within 1‑2 months a video of the robot performing unscripted work will be released to demonstrate real AI capability; if all goes well, AI‑5 will be integrated into Optimus by April next year, raising compute by an order of magnitude; and by around the end of next year Optimus will be delivered to companies outside Tesla, with initial high‑value use cases in 24‑hour heavy‑industry, hazardous and repetitive jobs.
He added, "I still believe Optimus will become the greatest product on Earth. Overall, humanoid robots will be the greatest product on the planet."
Terafab chip factory: To fully solve semiconductor compute and supply‑chain bottlenecks, Tesla is rapidly advancing its in‑house chip‑fabrication plant, Terafab, in Austin, Texas.

Musk said the plant is scheduled to begin equipment commissioning in the first half of next year, aiming to produce the first test chips in May‑June and achieve volume production of commercially viable chips by Q3 2028.

This effort is not only a technical undertaking but also requires massive capital. Musk disclosed that capital equipment spending will reach several hundred billion dollars before early 2028, and over the long term the total investment will far exceed $100 billion.

Musk positions Terafab as a "necessary asset" for large‑scale Optimus expansion, arguing that solving memory, packaging and logic‑chip bottlenecks is essential for robot industrialization. He believes the investment is justified, stating on X that Terafab could become the world's most valuable building, with economic value comparable to that of the top‑20 nations.

items.title: 貝森特閉門會議向華爾街放話：看不出AI有什麼「系統性風險」
items.title_en: Biden's Closed-Door Meeting Sends Message to Wall Street: Sees No Systemic Risk from AI
paras: 英國《金融時報》報導，美國財政部長貝森特週三 (21 日) 在紐約一場華爾街閉門會議上表示，他看不出人工智慧 (AI) 產業有什麼系統性風險，並以「這不是 Pets.com」駁斥市場將這波 AI 熱潮與網路泡沫相提並論的看法。
Pets.com 是美國線上寵物用品零售商，2000 年 2 月上市，同年 11 月就宣布結束營運，上市到關站不到 1 年，成為網路泡沫破裂的知名案例。
近期 AI 類股反覆震盪，投資人持續檢視相關股價漲勢是否過度，以及企業為興建資料中心、採購晶片而大舉舉債的風險。貝森特此時表態，為市場對 AI 投資熱潮能否延續的辯論增添分量。
這場活動由摩根大通與扶貧非營利組織羅賓漢基金會 (Robin Hood) 共同主辦，入場票價從 7,500 美元起跳，未開放媒體採訪。貝森特在橋水執行長 Nir Bar Dea 主持的訪談中，向數百名金融業高階主管與投資人分享對美國經濟及 AI 的看法。
據 3 名與會人士轉述，貝森特表示：「我很擅長辨識一個體系何時出了問題。我沒有看到任何系統性問題。」
他也以網路泡沫時期的代表企業 Pets.com 為例，否定兩者的類比，並以科技企業領導人的成就與持股，說明自己對 AI 發展的信心。
貝森特表示，這些人是「世界上最聰明的人」，99% 的財富與旗下公司綁在一起，而且已打造出全球最賺錢的企業，「他們相信這件事」。
整體而言，貝森特對 AI 可為美國帶來的效益抱持樂觀態度。不過，他也指出，資料中心業者與 AI 公司尚未充分向一般民眾說明，這項技術能為他們帶來哪些好處。
除了 AI 相關發言，這場活動的閉門形式也引發外界對政府官員與市場人士溝通透明度的關注。活動最高贊助方案達 10 萬美元，其他講者包括知名投資人朱肯米勒 (Stanley Druckenmiller) 與避險基金經理人柯恩 (Steve Cohen)。
美國財政部發言人表示，貝森特在公私部門擁有 35 年金融業經驗，充分了解何謂重大未公開資訊，且他在活動中的所有發言，都曾事先公開表達。
羅賓漢基金會傳播長 Kevin Thompson 則表示，這場會議多年來大多採取不開放媒體的閉門形式，也曾邀請多位現任及前任政府顧問與內閣官員出席。活動今年邁入第 14 年，迄今已募得近 7,200 萬美元。
前美國財政部長葉倫受訪時表示，她發表談話時，一向會確保媒體在場。她指出，過去擔任聯準會主席的經驗，讓她深知向有限受眾傳達敏感資訊可能帶來的風險。
聯準會規範要求，官員與外界互動時，不應讓任何營利個人或機構取得競爭優勢，並建議聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 官員在有媒體出席的活動中發言。
不過，目前並無規定禁止財政部長在媒體不在場的情況下，向大批私人市場參與者發表談話。
保守派法律非營利組織 Article III Project 創辦人 Mike Davis 則為活動辯護，強調這是一場慈善活動，認為應鼓勵政府官員參與這類場合。
paras_en: The Financial Times reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen (note: the article refers to "Bai Sen Te" which is a transliteration of "Biden"; assuming it is Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen) said at a closed‑door Wall Street meeting in New York on Wednesday the 21st that she sees no systemic risk in the artificial‑intelligence (AI) industry, dismissing the view that the current AI boom is comparable to the dot‑com bubble with the remark “this is not Pets.com.”

Pets.com was an online pet‑supplies retailer that went public in February 2000 and announced it would cease operations in November of the same year, disappearing in less than a year and becoming a well‑known example of the dot‑com crash.

AI‑related stocks have been swinging back and forth recently, with investors scrutinizing whether price gains are excessive and whether companies are taking on large debt loads to build data centers and buy chips. Biden’s comments at this moment add weight to the debate over whether the AI investment frenzy can be sustained.

The event was co‑hosted by JPMorgan Chase and the anti‑poverty nonprofit Robin Hood Foundation, with tickets starting at $7,500 and no media access. In an interview moderated by Bridgewater founder Nir Bar Dea, Biden shared his views on the U.S. economy and AI with hundreds of senior finance executives and investors.
According to three attendees, Biden said, “I’m good at spotting when a system is broken. I don’t see any systemic problem.”
He also used Pets.com, a hallmark of the dot‑com era, as a counterexample and cited the achievements and equity stakes of technology‑sector leaders to illustrate his confidence in AI’s development.

Biden said those people are “the smartest in the world,” that 99% of their wealth is tied to their companies, and that they have built the most profitable enterprises on the planet, “they believe in this.”

Overall, Biden expressed optimism about the benefits AI could bring to the United States, but he also noted that data‑center operators and AI firms have not yet adequately explained to the public what advantages the technology can deliver.

Beyond AI remarks, the closed‑door format of the event sparked concerns about transparency in communication between government officials and market participants. The top sponsorship tier was $100,000, and other speakers included well‑known investor Stanley Druckenmiller and hedge‑fund manager Steve Cohen.

A Treasury spokesperson said Biden has 35 years of experience in the financial sector across public and private roles, fully understands what constitutes material non‑public information, and that all of his remarks at the event had been disclosed in advance.

Robin Hood’s communications chief Kevin Thompson said the meeting has traditionally been media‑free and has invited numerous current and former government advisers and cabinet members over the years. This year marks the 14th edition of the event, which has raised nearly $72 million to date.

Former Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen told reporters that she always ensures media presence when she speaks. She noted that her experience as former Fed chair makes her keenly aware of the risks of conveying sensitive information to a limited audience.

Federal Reserve rules require that officials not give any profit‑seeking individual or entity a competitive edge when interacting with outsiders, and they advise that FOMC members speak only at events with media attendance.
However, there is currently no rule prohibiting the Treasury secretary from addressing a large private‑market audience when the media are not present.

Mike Davis, founder of the conservative nonprofit Article III Project, defended the event, emphasizing that it is a charitable gathering and arguing that government officials should be encouraged to participate in such forums.

items.title: 〈財報〉IBM Q3優預期、上修軟體展望 盤後先漲後跌
items.title_en: IBM Q3 Beats Expectations, Raises Software Outlook; Stock Rises Then Falls After Hours
paras: IBM(IBM-US)股價週三(21日)盤後先漲後跌，截稿前下跌約4%，第三季財報表現為公司重塑市場形象跨出一步，但華爾街認為，未來仍有一段長路要走。
IBM週三盤後公布2026會計年度第三季財報，調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為2.95美元，高於分析師預估的2.85美元。營收較去年同期成長4.7%，達171億美元，也超越華爾街預期的168億美元。儘管營收成長速度較前一季略有加快，但仍遠低於第一季9.5%的成長率。
成長最明顯的是軟體部門，營收增加8%至78億美元，高於分析師預估的76.6億美元。基礎架構部門營收成長4%，達37.1億美元。顧問服務部門營收則大致持平，為53.4億美元。
執行長Arvind Krishna接受《路透社》採訪時表示，公司目前預期全年軟體營收將成長約7%至8%，高於先前預估的6%至8%。

Q3 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：171 億美元 v.s. 168 億美元
調整後EPS：2.95 美元 v.s. 2.85 美元


市場反應說明投資人至今仍未完全擺脫第二季財報帶來的衝擊。IBM於7月14日罕見提前發布業績預告，股價隨後重挫25%，創下史上最差單日表現。
此後，IBM股價一直未能明顯反彈。截至目前，與7月13日收盤價相比，股價仍下跌逾13%。
除了第二季業績令人失望外，IBM長期面臨內生成長疲弱的問題，也是華爾街不願過度樂觀的原因。為了抵銷成長放緩的影響，IBM近年來持續透過收購軟體公司擴大業務，重要交易包括收購Red Hat、HashiCorp及Confluent。
Jefferies分析師Brent Thill將IBM第三季形容為「有待證明的故事」。他承認，財報公布前市場的預期門檻已經降低，但也指出，在第二季因執行不力及大型主機交易延遲而導致獲利不如預期後，市場預期已逐漸回歸正常。
IBM週三表示，先前延遲的交易中，約有三分之二已在第三季完成。儘管這並未促使公司上調營收展望，管理層仍重申全年營收成長4%至5%的預測，但公司調高了另一項財務指標的預期。
Krishna表示，受惠於最新一季「強勁的自由現金流」，公司目前預期全年自由現金流將較前一年增加逾10億美元。
儘管此次財報新聞稿並未特別提及，IBM的量子運算業務仍值得關注。數十年的研究投入，使公司成為該領域早期的技術與商業領導者之一，也是美國政府的重要合作夥伴。
本月稍早，IBM在一項聯邦量子運算基準測試計畫中晉級最後階段，獲得重要肯定。該計畫旨在以獨立方式評估參與者的進展，檢視各方能否在2033年前打造出具實用價值及錯誤校正能力的量子運算系統。
第三季財報或許為投資人帶來一線曙光，但摩根士丹利提醒，未來幾個月IBM將面臨更高的營收成長期待，以及更具挑戰性的宏觀經濟環境。
分析師指出，隨著先前延遲的交易終於完成，最新業績「應被視為中性偏正面」，但「此後情勢將更具挑戰性」。
paras_en: IBM (IBM-US) shares rose then fell after Wednesday's (the 21st) after‑hours trading, ending down about 4% before the deadline. The Q3 earnings mark a step forward in the company’s effort to reshape its market image, but Wall Street says a long road still lies ahead.

IBM announced its fiscal 2026 third‑quarter results after the market closed on Wednesday. Adjusted earnings per share were $2.95, above analysts’ estimate of $2.85. Revenue grew 4.7% year‑over‑year to $17.1 billion, also beating Wall Street’s forecast of $16.8 billion. Although the revenue growth rate accelerated slightly from the prior quarter, it remained far below the 9.5% growth seen in Q1.

The software segment showed the strongest growth, with revenue up 8% to $7.8 billion, surpassing the $7.66 billion analysts expected. Infrastructure revenue rose 4% to $3.71 billion, while consulting services revenue was essentially flat at $5.34 billion.
CEO Arvind Krishna told Reuters the company now expects full‑year software revenue to grow about 7%‑8%, higher than the previous outlook of 6%‑8%.

Q3 key figures versus LSEG estimates: Revenue $17.1 billion vs. $16.8 billion; Adjusted EPS $2.95 vs. $2.85. The market reaction shows investors have not fully shaken off the impact of the second‑quarter results. IBM unusually released an earnings preview on July 14, after which the stock plunged 25%, marking its worst single‑day performance on record.
Since then IBM’s share price has failed to rebound noticeably. To date the stock remains down more than 13% compared with its closing price on July 13.

Beyond the disappointing second‑quarter results, IBM’s long‑standing issue of weak organic growth also dampens Wall Street optimism. To offset slowing growth, IBM has continued to expand through software acquisitions in recent years, including Red Hat, HashiCorp and Confluent.

Jefferies analyst Brent Thill described IBM’s third quarter as a “story that still needs to be proven.” He acknowledged that market expectations had already been lowered before the earnings release, but noted that after the second quarter’s under‑performance due to execution lapses and delayed mainframe deals, expectations are gradually returning to normal.

IBM said on Wednesday that about two‑thirds of the previously delayed transactions were completed in the third quarter. Although this did not prompt an upward revision of the revenue outlook, management reiterated its forecast of 4%‑5% full‑year revenue growth, while raising expectations for another financial metric.
Krishna said that, buoyed by a “strong free cash flow” in the latest quarter, the company now expects full‑year free cash flow to increase by more than $1 billion versus the prior year.

While the press release did not call attention to it, IBM’s quantum computing business remains noteworthy. Decades of research have made the company one of the early technology and commercial leaders in the field and a key partner of the U.S. government.

Earlier this month IBM advanced to the final stage of a federal quantum‑computing benchmark program, earning significant recognition. The program independently assesses participants’ progress and examines whether they can deliver a quantum system with practical value and error‑correction capability by 2033.

The third‑quarter results may offer investors a glimmer of hope, but Morgan Stanley warns that IBM will face higher revenue‑growth expectations and a more challenging macro‑economic environment in the coming months.
Analysts note that with the previously delayed deals finally completed, the latest results “should be seen as neutral‑to‑slightly‑positive,” but “the road ahead will be more challenging.”

items.title: SpaceX、美超微財報提振AI信心，那指漲1.05%、費半勁揚2%
items.title_en: SpaceX and Super Micro Computer Earnings Boost AI Confidence, Nasdaq Up 1.05%, Philly Semiconductor Index Soars 2%
paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股21日收高，SpaceX與美超微Super Micro Computer(SMCI-US)財報提振AI投資信心，帶動科技股與半導體股反彈，那斯達克指數上漲1.05%，費城半導體指數勁揚2%。不過，SpaceX拓展行動通訊業務也加深市場競爭疑慮，電信股走弱，限制大盤漲幅。
道瓊工業指數上漲360.21點、漲幅0.69%，收52,856.09點；標普500指數上漲44.60點、漲幅0.58%，收7,757.17點；那斯達克指數上漲278.04點，收26,702.86點。標普500資訊科技類股上漲1.6%，為11大類股中表現最佳。
SpaceX(SPCX-US)公布上市後首次單季獲利，股價收漲7.8%。馬斯克在財報公布後表示，與特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)合併是個「好主意」，也帶動特斯拉收漲3.4%。
美超微則因預估季度營收與利潤率優於華爾街預期，股價大漲9.6%，躋身標普500當日漲幅最大個股之列。市場將其展望視為AI需求仍具韌性的訊號，並帶動慧與HPE(HPE-US)上漲3.7%、戴爾Dell(DELL-US)上漲5.3%。
兩家公司財報暫時緩解市場對AI大額投資能否回收的疑慮。上週AI相關股票遭到拋售，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)成為賣壓焦點；Edward Jones全球資深策略師Angelo Kourkafas表示，SpaceX與美超微的業績有助回應部分擔憂，雖尚未解答所有投資回報問題，仍是正面開始。
AI利多卻成為電信股壓力。市場擔心SpaceX在近期收購無線頻譜後，可能成為更強勁的競爭者，AT&T(T-US)即使第三季營收與獲利優於預期，股價仍重挫6.5%；T-Mobile US(TMUS-US)下跌2.5%，威瑞森Verizon(VZ-US)下跌2.2%。
通訊服務類股下跌1.3%，為大盤主要壓力來源。Netflix(NFLX-US)因第四季獲利展望不如預期，股價下跌5.3%；Alphabet(GOOGL-US)下跌1.6%。

paras_en: On October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. stocks closed higher on the 21st, with earnings from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) lifting AI investment confidence and sparking a rebound in technology and semiconductor shares. The Nasdaq rose 1.05% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 2%. However, SpaceX’s expansion into mobile communications raised competitive concerns, weakening telecom stocks and limiting the market’s upside.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 360.21 points, up 0.69% to 52,856.09; the S&P 500 rose 44.60 points, up 0.58% to 7,757.17; and the Nasdaq added 278.04 points to close at 26,702.86. S&P 500 information‑technology stocks climbed 1.6%, the best performance among the 11 major sectors.

SpaceX (SPCX-US) reported its first quarterly profit since going public, with the stock closing up 7.8%. After the earnings release, Elon Musk said a merger with Tesla (TSLA-US) would be a “good idea,” which helped Tesla shares rise 3.4%.

Super Micro Computer surged 9.6% after forecasting quarterly revenue and margins ahead of Wall Street expectations, making it the biggest gainer in the S&P 500 that day. The market viewed its outlook as a sign that AI demand remains resilient, lifting related stocks such as HPE (HPE-US) up 3.7% and Dell (DELL-US) up 5.3%.

The two earnings reports temporarily eased concerns about whether large AI investments can be recouped. Last week AI‑related stocks were sold off, with CoreWeave (CRWV-US) bearing the brunt of the pressure; senior global strategist Angelo Kourkafas of Edward Jones said the results from SpaceX and Super Micro help address some worries, though they do not answer all questions about investment returns, and remain a positive start.

Despite the AI tailwinds, telecom stocks came under pressure. The market fears that after SpaceX’s recent purchase of wireless spectrum it could become a stronger competitor, causing AT&T (T-US) – even though its third‑quarter revenue and profit beat expectations – to tumble 6.5%; T‑Mobile US (TMUS-US) fell 2.5% and Verizon (VZ-US) slipped 2.2%.

Communication‑services stocks dropped 1.3%, becoming a main drag on the market. Netflix (NFLX-US) fell 5.3% after its fourth‑quarter earnings outlook missed expectations, and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) slipped 1.6%.

items.title: Meta上修AI資本支出至1,450億美元 Muse用戶突破千萬、明年開始貢獻營收
items.title_en: Meta Raises AI Capital Expenditure Forecast to $145 Billion; Muse Users Surpass 10 Million, Revenue Contribution Expected Next Year
paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Facebook母公司Meta Platforms(META-US)21日公布第三季營收646億美元（約新台幣2.09兆元），優於市場預期的633.7億美元，並上調2026年資本支出預估下限。公司表示，2027年將持續積極投資核心業務與AI，具體支出金額仍在規劃，預計第四季法說會提供更明確指引。財報公布後，股價盤後上漲逾4%。
Meta將今年資本支出預估由1,300億至1,450億美元，調整為1,350億至1,450億美元（約新台幣4.37兆至4.70兆元），包含融資租賃本金支付。財務長Susan Li表示，2027年預算與產能規劃仍處於早期階段，公司正評估不同回收期間的投資案，希望在整體預算與財務目標內，支應更多具吸引力的投資機會，目前尚未公布明年資本支出金額或增幅。
隨著AI晶片與資料中心投資增加，Meta第三季資本支出達349億美元，自由現金流也由去年同期流入106.3億美元，轉為流出21.2億美元。公司預估第四季營收介於730億至760億美元，區間中值745億美元，高於市場預期的737.3億美元。
在新業務方面，Meta推出的AI代理服務Muse，上市六週已有美國與加拿大超過1,000萬名用戶建立帳號。執行長祖克柏Mark Zuckerberg表示，現階段優先擴大用戶與企業使用規模，長期希望服務數十億人。由於AI代理的運算成本高於過去多數產品，公司計畫更早啟動收費，Susan Li預期，AI業務將從2027年開始貢獻額外營收。
Meta也持續調整資源配置，將部分投資由Reality Labs轉向AI等優先發展領域，預估Reality Labs在2027年的虧損將縮減至約150億美元。此外，公司宣布規劃發行不具投票權的C類普通股，既有股東每持有一股將獲配一股新股，實質效果相當於一拆二，預計2027年1月底開始交易。
獲利方面，Meta第三季稀釋每股盈餘為3.83美元，主要受到先前與美國各州達成和解所認列的98.9億美元費用影響；若排除相關費用，每股盈餘約7.40美元。公司表示，仍持續關注用戶隱私與青少年安全等法律及監管案件，相關進展可能影響後續營運與財務表現。

paras_en: October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Meta Platforms (META‑US), the parent of Facebook, reported third‑quarter revenue of $64.6 billion (about NT$2.09 trillion), beating market expectations of $63.37 billion, and raised the lower bound of its 2026 capital‑expenditure outlook. The company said it will continue to invest aggressively in its core business and AI in 2027, with specific spending amounts still being planned and clearer guidance expected at the fourth‑quarter earnings call. After the earnings release, the stock rose more than 4% in after‑hours trading.

Meta adjusted its capital‑expenditure estimate for this year from $130 billion‑$150 billion to a range of $135 billion‑$145 billion (about NT$4.37 trillion‑$4.70 trillion), including principal payments on finance leases. CFO Susan Li said the 2027 budget and capacity planning are still in early stages; the company is evaluating investment projects with different payback periods and hopes to fund more attractive opportunities within the overall budget and financial targets. The exact 2027 capital‑expenditure amount or increase has not been disclosed yet.

With higher AI‑chip and data‑center spending, Meta’s Q3 capital expenditure reached $34.9 billion, and free cash flow swung from an inflow of $10.63 billion a year earlier to an outflow of $2.12 billion. The company forecasts Q4 revenue between $73 billion and $76 billion, with a midpoint of $74.5 billion, above the market estimate of $73.73 billion.

In new‑business news, Meta’s AI‑agent service Muse has amassed over 10 million users in the United States and Canada within six weeks of launch. CEO Mark Zuckerberg said the current priority is to expand user and enterprise adoption, with a long‑term goal of serving billions of people. Because AI agents have higher compute costs than most of Meta’s other products, the company plans to start charging earlier, and Susan Li expects the AI business to begin contributing additional revenue starting in 2027.

Meta is also reshuffling resources, shifting some investment away from Reality Labs toward priority areas such as AI. The loss at Reality Labs is projected to shrink to roughly $15 billion in 2027. In addition, the company announced plans to issue non‑voting Class C common stock, giving existing shareholders one new share for each share they hold – effectively a 1‑for‑2 split – with trading expected to begin at the end of January 2027.

On the profitability side, Meta reported diluted earnings per share of $3.83 for Q3, primarily impacted by a $9.89 billion expense recorded for settlements with various U.S. states; excluding that charge, EPS would have been about $7.40. The company said it continues to monitor legal and regulatory matters related to user privacy and teen safety, which could affect future operations and financial performance.

items.title: 黃仁勳GTC重點一次看 新晶片量產、AI工廠裝箱出貨、搶攻機器人
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's GTC Highlights: New Chip Mass Production, AI Factory Shipping, Robot Push
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳在柏林GTC大會表示，AI正開啟新一輪工業革命，企業不僅要使用AI，更應成為AI的生產者。他宣布Vera Rubin全面量產，並介紹模組化AI工廠、AI代理安全平台、自駕車與人形機器人布局，強調輝達已從GPU供應商，發展為提供完整AI工廠平台的企業。
黃仁勳指出，當新技術改變製造方式，以及人類能夠創造的事物，工業革命便會發生。AI如同電力，將影響各行各業，並催生新產業，目前仍處於初期階段。
AI如同電力 歐洲須建立自己的產業
他將AI產業比喻為「五層蛋糕」，由能源、運算、AI基礎設施、模型與應用組成。能源驅動電腦，電腦構成AI工廠，模型在工廠中產生token，再將數位智慧融入應用。因此，AI不只是軟體，也是一種持續生產智慧的製造業。
黃仁勳表示，輝達過去一年在歐洲投資近100億美元，涵蓋新創企業及合作計畫，並已建立超過1.2萬項合作關係。他強調，歐洲要建立AI經濟，關鍵在於汽車、製造、醫療與金融等產業全面採用AI，將既有專業轉化為競爭力。
Vera Rubin量產 系統整合推升效能
黃仁勳表示，輝達透過晶片、系統、軟體與演算法的協同設計，過去十年將AI效能提升100萬倍。隨著摩爾定律逼近極限，效能進步必須仰賴整套系統共同創新。
他宣布Vera Rubin已全面量產，採用全液冷及無纜線設計，運算節點組裝時間由Grace Blackwell的兩小時，縮短至不到五分鐘，改善製造效率與可靠性。NVLink則可將72個GPU連接為一套大型運算系統。
黃仁勳指出，新平台不只處理語言模型，也涵蓋AI代理的執行框架、資料處理及工具運算，支援代理從思考到完成工作的完整流程。
網路方面，輝達展示採用共同封裝光學（CPO）技術的Spectrum-X交換器，運用與台積電共同開發的COUPE製程，讓光學元件直接連接晶片。黃仁勳表示，產品已全面量產，具備512個連接埠，每埠傳輸速率為200 Gb/s。
AI工廠模組化 縮短部署與資金閒置
黃仁勳表示，一座1 GW的AI工廠造價約500億美元，涵蓋運算、網路、儲存、供電及冷卻等設備，僅有高效能晶片並不足夠，還必須整合整座工廠的設計與營運。
輝達DSX參考架構從數位孿生出發，在施工前模擬效能、電力、用水與散熱。據介紹，DSX Max-Q可動態調配電力，在相同產出下減少30%耗電量。
Vera Rubin的封閉式液冷系統可使用最高攝氏45度的冷卻液，在氣候適宜地區，透過室外乾式冷卻器散熱，減少蒸發用水。輝達表示，在2 GW規模下，每日可節省5,400萬公升水。
新推出的DSX Pod則將設備整合、布線及測試移至工廠完成，再以貨櫃運送。現場公用設施就緒後，部署時間預計可由數月縮短至數天；黃仁勳另估計，設備到貨至正式生產token的整體流程，可由四至五個月縮短至約一個月，降低閒置算力與資本支出的浪費。
AI代理帶動需求 安全不能只靠口頭要求
黃仁勳表示，AI代理能夠推理、反覆嘗試並使用工具，實用性提高的同時，也消耗更多token，進而帶動GPU需求成長。
他將AI代理拆解為模型、執行框架、安全沙箱、知識與工具五個部分。其中，安全是部署自主系統的前提，不能只是要求AI「不要刪除資料」或「不要碰金鑰」，而須透過工程機制限制權限。
輝達推出的OpenShell，能在系統呼叫、檔案存取及網路連線層級執行政策。代理在獨立沙箱內運作，對外連線須經外部監管元件檢查，金鑰也保留在沙箱外，避免代理直接持有。
另一項安全機制Sentry運行於BlueField 4，在與代理隔離的硬體環境中監控活動。依輝達介紹，若發現代理計畫執行非預期操作，可在毫秒內切斷其模型連線並隔離。黃仁勳也宣布，輝達正與Anthropic合作開發Claude OpenShell代理。
企業價值在知識與工具 軟體業將迎更多用戶
黃仁勳認為，企業未來將同時使用閉源模型及客製化開放模型，依任務選擇最適合的工具，單一模型無法包辦一切。
輝達持續提供Nemotron語言模型、Cosmos世界基礎模型等開放模型，讓企業利用自身資料進行後續訓練。他強調，讓AI代理具備專業能力的關鍵，是企業掌握的知識與工具。
例如，Lila Sciences利用BioNeMo及CUDA-X工具設計蛋白質與化合物，將虛擬實驗結果送交實體實驗室驗證；西門子利用AI代理規劃生產，再透過數位孿生檢驗；達梭系統則讓代理協助車門設計、模擬及修正，最後由工程師審查方案。
對於AI可能終結軟體與工具公司的說法，黃仁勳持相反看法。他認為，AI代理仍須依靠專業工具完成工作，將為工具帶來更多使用者，軟體公司也將提供擅長操作自家產品的代理服務。
實體AI接棒 自駕車與機器人擴大布局
黃仁勳將能理解物理世界並採取行動的「實體AI」，視為下一波浪潮，應用不僅包括機器人，也涵蓋電信基地台及自適應放射治療。
他表示，輝達與諾基亞經過近八年努力，已在T-Mobile網路完成首次商業通話，後續可在既有運算架構上加入AI，提升頻譜效率，並讓電信設施逐步成為分散式AI基礎設施。
自駕車方面，輝達透過Hyperion參考架構，整合攝影機、雷達、光達及運算系統，讓車商與自駕軟體業者共同開發，並串接叫車平台。黃仁勳宣布，福斯商旅、捷豹路虎、Volvo及賓士的新車型將加入相關布局。
在人形機器人領域，他認為標準化外型有助擴大產量，形成持續改良的循環。若機器人能透過示範快速學習，中小企業便不必建立完整研發團隊，也能導入應用。
輝達並與思靈機器人合作推出Agile One參考機器人，預計於演講所指的明年第一季上市，預先整合電腦與軟體，縮短開發時間。
個人電腦轉型 成為能執行任務的助手
黃仁勳表示，個人電腦將逐步成為個人AI助手，除了模型，也須具備執行框架、安全環境，以及存取知識與工具的能力。
他介紹輝達與微軟合作四年打造的RTX Spark系列，採用N1X晶片，涵蓋桌機、筆電與工作站，提供1 PFLOPS算力及128 GB記憶體；搭載Windows的DGX Station則提供20 PFLOPS算力與754 GB記憶體，預計於演講所指的年底上市。
演講最後，輝達展示利用RTX Spark建立機器人訓練場景，結合雲端平行訓練，再將驗證後的策略部署到實體機器人。
黃仁勳藉此說明，AI代理與實體AI正逐步串接，讓個人電腦從操作工具，走向協助使用者規劃、設計並完成工作的夥伴。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said at the Berlin GTC that AI is launching a new industrial revolution; companies should not only use AI but become AI producers. He announced full‑scale production of Vera Rubin and introduced a modular AI factory, an AI‑agent security platform, and plans for autonomous vehicles and humanoid robots, stressing that Nvidia has evolved from a GPU supplier to a provider of a complete AI‑factory platform.

Huang noted that an industrial revolution occurs when new technology changes how things are manufactured and what humans can create. AI, like electricity, will affect every industry and spawn new sectors, and we are still in the early stage.
AI is like electricity – Europe must build its own industry

He likened the AI industry to a five‑layer cake made of energy, compute, AI infrastructure, models and applications. Energy powers computers, computers form the AI factory, models generate tokens inside the factory, and digital intelligence is infused into applications. Thus AI is not just software but a manufacturing process that continuously produces intelligence.

Huang said Nvidia has invested nearly $10 billion in Europe over the past year across startups and partnership programs and has established more than 12,000 collaborations. He emphasized that Europe’s AI economy depends on automotive, manufacturing, healthcare and finance fully adopting AI, turning existing expertise into competitive advantage.
Vera Rubin mass production boosts system integration performance

Huang explained that by co‑designing chips, systems, software and algorithms, Nvidia has increased AI performance a million‑fold over the past decade. As Moore’s Law nears its limits, further gains must come from system‑wide innovation.

He announced that Vera Rubin is now in full production, featuring full‑liquid cooling and a cable‑free design. Assembly time for a compute node has dropped from two hours (Grace Blackwell) to under five minutes, improving manufacturing efficiency and reliability. NVLink can connect 72 GPUs into a single large compute system.

Huang said the new platform handles not only language models but also the execution framework for AI agents, data processing and tool compute, supporting an agent’s end‑to‑end workflow from reasoning to task completion.

On the networking side, Nvidia showcased the Spectrum‑X switch built with co‑packaged optics (CPO) using the COUPE process co‑developed with TSMC, which directly attaches optical components to the chip. Huang said the product is now in full production, offering 512 ports at 200 Gb/s each.
Modular AI factory shortens deployment and idle capital

Huang stated that a 1 GW AI factory costs about $50 billion and includes compute, networking, storage, power and cooling equipment. High‑performance chips alone are insufficient; the entire factory’s design and operation must be integrated.

Nvidia’s DSX reference architecture starts from a digital twin to simulate performance, power, water use and heat before construction. DSX Max‑Q can dynamically allocate power, cutting energy use by 30% for the same output.

Vera Rubin’s closed‑loop liquid‑cooling system can use coolant up to 45 °C; in suitable climates it can be cooled by outdoor dry coolers, reducing evaporative water use. Nvidia said a 2 GW deployment can save 54 million liters of water per day.

The new DSX Pod integrates equipment, wiring and testing at the factory and ships it in containers. Once site utilities are ready, deployment time can shrink from months to days; Huang estimates the whole process from equipment arrival to production tokens can drop from four‑to‑five months to about one month, reducing idle compute and capital waste.
AI agents drive demand; safety can’t rely on verbal rules alone
Huang said AI agents can reason, iterate and use tools, increasing usefulness but also consuming more tokens, which in turn drives GPU demand growth.

He broke AI agents into five components: model, execution framework, security sandbox, knowledge and tools. Security is a prerequisite for deploying autonomous systems and cannot rely merely on telling the AI “don’t delete data” or “don’t touch keys”; it must be enforced through engineering controls that limit permissions.

Nvidia’s OpenShell can enforce policies at the system‑call, file‑access and network‑connection layers. Agents run inside isolated sandboxes; external connections must pass through a supervisory component, and keys remain outside the sandbox to prevent agents from holding them directly.

Another security mechanism, Sentry, runs on BlueField 4 and monitors activity in a hardware‑isolated environment separate from the agent. Nvidia says if an agent attempts an unexpected operation, Sentry can cut its model connection and isolate it within milliseconds. Huang also announced Nvidia’s collaboration with Anthropic to develop a Claude OpenShell agent.
Enterprise value lies in knowledge and tools; software firms will see more users
Huang believes enterprises will use both closed‑source models and custom open models, selecting the best tool for each task; no single model can do everything.

Nvidia continues to offer open models such as Nemotron and the Cosmos world model, enabling companies to fine‑tune them with their own data. He stressed that giving AI agents professional capability hinges on the knowledge and tools that enterprises possess.

For example, Lila Sciences uses BioNeMo and CUDA‑X tools to design proteins and compounds, sending virtual experiment results to physical labs for validation; Siemens uses AI agents to plan production and then verifies via digital twins; Dassault Systemes lets agents assist with door design, simulation and revision, with engineers reviewing the final proposals.

When asked whether AI could end software and tool companies, Huang disagreed. He said AI agents still need specialized tools to get work done, which will bring more users to those tools, and software firms will also provide agents that are experts at using their own products.
Physical AI takes the baton: autonomous‑vehicle and robot expansion
Huang described “physical AI” – AI that can understand the physical world and act in it – as the next wave, covering robots, telecom base stations and adaptive radiation therapy.

He noted that after nearly eight years of work with Nokia, Nvidia completed its first commercial call on T‑Mobile’s network; AI can later be added to the existing compute stack to improve spectrum efficiency and turn telecom infrastructure into distributed AI nodes.

In autonomous vehicles, Nvidia’s Hyperion reference architecture integrates cameras, radar, lidar and compute, enabling car makers and self‑driving software firms to co‑develop and connect to ride‑hailing platforms. Huang announced that new models from Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, Jaguar Land Rover, Volvo and Mercedes‑Benz will incorporate these capabilities.

In humanoid robotics, he said standardizing form factors helps scale production and creates a virtuous improvement cycle. If robots can learn quickly from demonstrations, small and medium enterprises won’t need full R&D teams to adopt them.

Nvidia, together with Agility Robotics, is launching the Agile One reference robot, slated for release in the first quarter of next year, with integrated compute and software to shorten development time.
Personal computers are transforming into task‑executing assistants
Huang said personal PCs will gradually become personal AI assistants; beyond models they must have execution frameworks, secure environments, and access to knowledge and tools.

He introduced the RTX Spark series, a four‑year Nvidia‑Microsoft collaboration built on the N1X chip, covering desktops, laptops and workstations, delivering 1 PFLOPS of compute and 128 GB of memory; the DGX Station running Windows offers 20 PFLOPS and 754 GB of memory and is expected to ship by year‑end.
At the close of his talk, Nvidia demonstrated building a robot training scenario with RTX Spark, combining cloud‑based parallel training and then deploying the validated policy to a physical robot.
Huang used this to illustrate that AI agents and physical AI are increasingly linked, turning personal computers from mere tool operators into partners that help users plan, design and complete work.

items.title: 〈台股開盤〉外資翻多激勵大盤開高漲逾400點 CCL、PCB強勢噴出
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Opens Higher as Foreign Investors Turn Net Buyers, Boosting Index Over 400 Points; CCL and PCB Sectors Surge
paras: 台北股市今(22)日早盤在外資在期貨及現貨同步翻多同時，由電子股帶動之下出現強勢反彈，台積電(2330-TW)以2435元開高 ，上漲0.62%，電子類股勁揚1%，並占大盤成交比重達 8%，資深證券分析師指出，台股在站上 5 日線後，後續的量能如能續增，將成有利多方反攻的格局形成。
在亞洲區域股市方面，日本日經及南韓股市早盤下跌，資深證券分析師簡伯儀指出，在美股包括Space X、Meta及美超微等企業已公布財報業績表現及展望佳之下，有利後續台股的醞釀再強攻格局。
台股集中市場加權股價指數22日以46942.75點開出，盤早一度上漲超過400點，爲台股連續下跌後的反彈，不過，集中市場盤面仍呈現量能仍待放大，預估今天全場成交值量僅約8860億元。
至昨日仍為外資重要提款對象的權王台積電，早盤一度上漲0.62%達2435元，鴻海(2317-TW)下跌、台達電(2308-TW)及聯發科(2454-TW)股價同步上漲。IC載板股方面，欣興(3037-TW)、南電(8046-TW)及景碩(3189-TW)全數上漲。
CCL類股台光電(2383-TW)漲停、聯茂(6213-TW)股價走高，其中聯茂股價早盤885元並創新天價。
台北股市昨日在電子股帶動之下出現強勢反彈，最後一盤交易爆發585億元鉅量，拉抬指數上漲160.56點，終場大盤收在46887.77點，上漲594.84點，成交值8331.91億元，並站上5日線，外資也中止對台股的連續10個交易日合計8380.64億元賣超，轉爲買超9.6億元。
外資昨天集中市場主要買超的標的，包括友達(2409-TW)、鴻海(及南亞(1303-TW)都超過2萬張。在期貨市場上 ，外資今天交易口數淨額爲多單1062口，未平倉淨額爲空單86072口。

統一證券指出，包括SpaceX、美超微與Meta強勁財報消弭市場對AI泡沫的悲觀情緒；輝達於柏林GTC大會再度點名多檔台灣供應鏈，強調AI創造新工業革命才剛開始，Rubin放量將創造更大算力供給。籌碼面，外資終結連續10個交易日合計賣超逾8,300億元的調節壓力，轉為小幅買超22億元，台股可望緩步挑戰10日線及月線。惟中東地緣局勢仍干擾能源市場，預期大盤震盪盤堅。建議保持適度資金彈性，避免過度槓桿，逢回布局，AI概念及業績題材股，搭配短期營收動能股，長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進封測、半導體設備、PCB供應鏈、光傳輸、散熱、連接器、貨櫃散裝、塑化及特用化學等。
台股的操作建議上，國票證券建議，隨TPCA展會揭示高階PCB與CCL材料升級趨勢，AI伺服器、高速光通訊及低軌衛星需求持續擴大，有利具備高階HDI製程、低損耗材料及供應鏈整合能力的業者提升競爭優勢，展望2027年，隨新一代AI平台導入及高階產品逐步放量，相關業者營運動能可望延續，操作上可留意高階PCB相關族群，若後續股價適度回檔，可伺機布局。
同時，輝達德國柏林GTC於昨日登場，輝達超大規模與高效能運算副總裁Ian Buck(伊恩·巴克)在展前記者會上宣布在歐洲建立主權AI工廠，合作夥伴為法國的BULL(布爾電腦)以及鴻海集團的捷克廠。此外，輝達更直接點名四大供應鏈未來將大舉擴產以配合這波AI基建，台系廠商包括欣興、京元電(2449-TW)、矽品都入列。
而市場AI 及儲能需求仍然強勁，繼電器廠松川精密 (7788-TW) 營運處於上升的軌道中，松川精密董事會21日決議，擬以15億元上限發行無擔保可轉換公司債(CB)進行籌資，這也是松川在2025年10月16日上市掛牌以來首度的市場籌資動作，主辦券商爲元大證券。
松川精密營運大幅成長中，松川精密2026年1-9月營收68.52億元，已超越2025年全年營收總和，年增幅達44%。公司並指出，此一市場籌資用途償還銀行借款及充實營運資金。
今晨收盤的美股表現佳，且全面收高，SpaceX 強勁財報與潛在合併特斯拉的消息，帶動資金回流科技股，緩解市場對人工智慧 (AI) 投資回報的疑慮。那斯達克指數上漲逾 1%，標普 500 指數連續第 3 個交易日收紅，道瓊則勁揚約 360 點。

美股收盤道瓊工業指數上漲 360.21 點，或 0.69%，報 52,856.09 點。那斯達克指數上漲 278.04 點，或 1.05%，報 26,702.86 點。S&P 500 指數上漲 44.60 點，或 0.58%，報 7,757.17 點。費城半導體指數上漲 221.74 點，或 1.97%，報 11,505.56 點。在台股指標方面，輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.54%；台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上揚 1.60%
paras_en: Taipei's stock market opened this morning (22nd) with foreign investors turning net buyers in both futures and spot markets, sparking a strong rebound led by electronics stocks. TSMC (2330-TW) opened at NT$2,435, up 0.62%, while the electronics sector jumped 1% and accounted for 8% of total market turnover. A senior securities analyst noted that once the market stays above its 5‑day moving average, continued volume growth could create a favorable environment for a bullish counter‑attack.

In Asian markets, Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI fell in early trading. Senior analyst Jian Boyi said that strong earnings reports and outlooks from U.S. companies such as SpaceX, Meta and AMD provide a tailwind for a renewed aggressive push in Taiwan equities.

The Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Index opened at 46,942.75 points on the 22nd, briefly climbing more than 400 points in early trading – a rebound after a series of declines. However, overall market volume remains modest, with total turnover estimated at about NT$886 billion for the day.

TSMC, still a key target for foreign investors, rose 0.62% to NT$2,435 in early trading. Hon Hai (2317‑TW) fell, while Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and MediaTek (2454‑TW) rose. All IC substrate stocks – Unimicron (3037‑TW), Nan Ya (8046‑TW) and Kinsus (3189‑TW) – posted gains.
CCL‑related stocks saw strong moves: Taiwan Optoelectronics (2383‑TW) hit its daily limit up, and Lianmao (6213‑TW) rose, trading at NT$885 in early trading, a new intraday high.

Yesterday, the market rallied sharply on the back of electronics stocks, with a massive NT$58.5 billion surge in the final session that lifted the index by 160.56 points. The session closed at 46,887.77 points, up 594.84 points, with turnover of NT$833.191 billion, and the index stayed above its 5‑day average. Foreign investors also reversed a ten‑day cumulative net sell of NT$8,380.64 billion into a net buy of NT$960 million.

Foreign investors’ biggest net‑buy targets in the main market yesterday included AU Optronics (2409‑TW), Hon Hai and Nanya (1303‑TW), each exceeding 20,000 lots. In the futures market, foreign investors posted a net long of 1,062 contracts today, with open‑interest net short at 86,072 contracts.

Unified Securities highlighted that strong earnings from SpaceX, AMD and Meta have eased pessimism about an AI bubble; NVIDIA reiterated at the Berlin GTC that multiple Taiwanese suppliers are critical as AI drives a new industrial revolution, and Rubin’s capacity expansion will boost computing power. On the chip‑holding side, foreign investors ended a ten‑day cumulative net sell of over NT$830 billion, turning to a modest net buy of NT$2.2 billion, allowing the market to gradually test the 10‑day and monthly averages. However, Middle‑East geopolitical tensions continue to disturb energy markets, so the index is expected to trade sideways. The recommendation is to keep capital flexible, avoid excessive leverage, and re‑enter on pullbacks, focusing on AI‑related concepts, earnings‑driven stocks, short‑term revenue‑momentum names, and long‑term themes such as TSMC, advanced packaging, semiconductor equipment, PCB supply chains, optical transmission, thermal solutions, connectors, bulk cargo, plastics and specialty chemicals.

For trading ideas, Guo Piao Securities advises that the TPCA exhibition has highlighted an upgrade trend for high‑end PCB and CCL materials. Looking to 2027, as next‑generation AI platforms roll out and high‑end products scale, operating momentum for these firms should continue. Investors may watch high‑end PCB groups and consider buying on modest pullbacks.

NVIDIA’s Berlin GTC took place yesterday, where NVIDIA’s senior VP of high‑performance computing Ian Buck announced plans to build a sovereign AI factory in Europe, partnering with France’s BULL and Hon Hai’s Czech plant.
