items.title: Meta祭新股留住祖克柏！加州富人稅恐逼他繳數十億美元 八年不得離開總部所在地
items.title_en: Meta Offers New Shares to Keep Zuckerberg; California Wealth Tax Could Force Him to Pay Tens of Billions, Must Stay at Headquarters for Eight Years
paras: Meta Platforms(META-US)周三(21日)表示，已與執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)簽署協議，確保他未來八年仍居住於公司總部所在的加州，不會因加州富人稅提案正式立法而離開。祖克柏為全球第五大富豪，目前身價達2470億美元。
祖克柏為全球第五大富豪，目前身價達2470億美元。他並不支持加州第40號提案(Proposition 40)，也就是俗稱的「加州富人稅」，並於周三稍早表示，若加州通過此提案，他考慮離開加州。加州選民將於下個月對這項公投提案作出決定。
根據Meta文件，該公司已透過提出新的股票計畫，成功說服祖克柏繼續留在加州。根據文件內容，祖克柏承諾未來八年內「持續居住於加州，或公司設有企業總部的其他司法管轄區」。
Meta指出，祖克柏考慮離開加州，是因為該州提出的富人稅可能使他面臨數十億美元的稅款，甚至迫使他出售具有投票權的股票來繳稅。
因此Meta表示，2027年1月新發行無投票權的C類普通股，部分目的就是避免這種情況發生。
祖克柏將取得不具投票權的C類股票，可在出售股票換取流動資金的同時，不必削弱自己對公司的投票控制權。作為交換，只要他繼續擔任全職領導職務，就承諾居住在加州，或Meta總部所在地。
根據協議，祖克柏可立即出售所獲C類股票的20%，相當於他整體經濟持股的10%。這將提供流動資金，協助他支付可能產生的稅款。其餘80%的C類股票最初受到出售限制，但只要祖克柏持續領導公司，相關限制就會在八年內逐步解除。
第40號提案由醫療照護工作者工會及加州進步派政治人物推動，包括聯邦眾議員Ro Khanna。這項稅收將影響2026年1月1日淨資產超過10億美元的人士，包括Google(GOOGL-US)共同創辦人布林(Sergey Brin)在內的部分全球富豪反對這項稅制，並已離開加州。近期民調顯示，這項提案的支持與反對陣營競爭激烈。
Meta特別委員會表示，讓祖克柏繼續在公司總部所在地工作「至關重要」，尤其是在人工智慧(AI)競賽日益激烈之際，祖克柏正與Meta超級智慧實驗室(Meta Superintelligence Labs)密切合作。
特別委員會也提到Covid-19情期間公司面臨的「困難」。當時祖克柏曾離開管理團隊所在之處，委員會不希望公司再次面臨類似挑戰。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) said on Wednesday (the 21st) that it has signed an agreement with CEO Mark Zuckerberg to ensure he will continue to reside in California, where the company’s headquarters are located, for the next eight years and will not leave even if the California wealth‑tax proposal becomes law. Zuckerberg is the world’s fifth‑richest person, with a net worth of $247 billion.

Zuckerberg, the world’s fifth‑richest person with a net worth of $247 billion, does not support California Proposition 40, commonly called the “California wealth tax,” and earlier on Wednesday said that if the state passes the measure he would consider leaving California. Voters will decide on the referendum next month.

According to Meta documents, the company has persuaded Zuckerberg to stay in California by introducing a new stock plan. The filing states that Zuckerberg has committed to continue living in California, or any other jurisdiction where the company has its corporate headquarters, for the next eight years.

Meta noted that Zuckerberg’s consideration of leaving California stems from the state’s proposed wealth tax, which could expose him to tens of billions of dollars in taxes and might even force him to sell voting‑share stock to pay the levy.
Therefore, Meta said that the non‑voting Class C common shares to be issued in January 2027 are partly intended to prevent that scenario.

Zuckerberg will receive non‑voting Class C shares, allowing him to raise cash by selling stock without diluting his voting control of the company. In exchange, he must remain in a full‑time leadership role and commit to residing in California or at Meta’s headquarters.

Under the agreement, Zuckerberg can immediately sell 20% of the Class C shares he receives, equivalent to 10% of his total economic stake, providing liquidity to help cover any potential tax bill. The remaining 80% of the Class C shares are initially subject to a sell‑restriction, which will be lifted gradually over eight years as long as he continues to lead the company.

Proposition 40 is backed by health‑care worker unions and progressive California politicians, including U.S. Representative Ro Khanna. The tax would affect anyone with net assets over $1 billion as of Jan 1 2026, and some global billionaires such as Google co‑founder Sergey Brin have opposed the measure and already left the state. Recent polls show a fierce battle between supporters and opponents.
Meta’s special committee said keeping Zuckerberg at the company’s headquarters is “critical,” especially as the AI race intensifies, with Zuckerberg working closely with Meta Superintelligence Labs.

The committee also referenced the “difficulties” the company faced during the Covid‑19 period, when Zuckerberg stepped away from the management team’s location, and said it does not want the firm to encounter a similar challenge again.

items.title: 二手溢價回落 供應激增 愛馬仕柏金包稀缺性神話鬆動
items.title_en: Second‑hand Premiums Decline as Supply Surges, Undermining the Hermes Birkin Scarcity Myth
paras: 愛馬仕標誌性鉑金包（Birkin）的神話正遭受前所未有考驗，二手市場供給激增，轉售溢價大幅收窄，令這一長期支撐愛馬仕估值的核心邏輯動搖。
鉑金包轉售價從新冠肺炎疫情高峰期快速回落。經紀商Bernstein追蹤的拍賣數據顯示，今年第三季Birkin 25的二手成交價約零售價的1.7倍，而2022年高峰時大約2.6倍。
據《路透社》報導，轉售商說，一款未使用的黑色Birkin 25——市場最搶手款式之一——二手價格自2022年以來已下跌約4,000英鎊（約合5,336美元），目前約2.4萬英鎊。部分賣家報價甚至低至2萬英鎊。愛馬仕在英國官方零售價為9,390英鎊。
在倫敦從事鉑金包轉售的蔡寶春表示，他在2020年開始通過Vestiaire Collective及社交媒體平台銷售鉑金包，一度從中獲取豐厚利潤，轉售價可達零售價兩倍以上。
如今，隨著未開封鉑金包的二手價較2022年峰值下跌逾6,000美元，他已停止囤貨。「我不想虧錢」，他說。
鉑金包之所以能長期維持高溢價，核心在於嚴格管控的供給與購買資格門檻。轉售商說，客戶通常需要在愛馬仕絲巾、服裝及鞋履上累計消費1萬至2萬美元，才有機會獲得購買鉑金包或凱莉包的資格。
然而，這一壁壘正在鬆動。愛馬仕近年來平均每年新開一家工坊，持續擴大手工皮具產能。
與此同時，Vestiaire Collective、The RealReal等二手交易平台興起，以及網店、社交媒體渠道普及，大幅降低了鉑金包轉售門檻。
加州二手奢侈品平台Fashionphile創始人Sarah Davis表示，該公司15年間鉑金包上架數量激增32倍，目前網站在售鉑金包多達212個。
paras_en: The iconic Hermes Birkin bag’s myth is facing an unprecedented test as the secondary market sees a flood of supply and resale premiums have sharply narrowed, shaking the core logic that has long underpinned Hermes’s valuation.

Birkin resale prices have fallen rapidly from their pandemic‑era peaks. Auction data tracked by broker Bernstein shows that in Q3 this year, a Birkin 25 fetched about 1.7 times its retail price on the secondary market, compared with roughly 2.6 times at the 2022 peak.

According to Reuters, a reseller said an unused black Birkin 25 – one of the most sought‑after styles – has dropped about £4,000 (≈$5,336) since 2022 and now trades around £24,000, with some sellers quoting as low as £20,000. Hermes’s official UK retail price is £9,390.

In London, Birkin reseller Cai Baochun said he began selling Birkin bags via Vestiaire Collective and social‑media platforms in 2020, at a time when he could earn hefty profits, with resale prices exceeding twice the retail price.
Now, with the secondary price of unopened Birkin bags more than $6,000 below the 2022 peak, he has stopped stocking them. “I don’t want to lose money,” he said.

The Birkin’s long‑standing high premium has been sustained by tightly controlled supply and strict purchase‑eligibility thresholds. Resellers note that customers typically need to spend $10,000‑$20,000 on Hermes scarves, apparel and shoes before they are eligible to buy a Birkin or Kelly bag.
However, that barrier is loosening. Hermes has been opening, on average, one new workshop each year in recent years, steadily expanding its handcrafted leather‑goods capacity.

At the same time, the rise of second‑hand platforms such as Vestiaire Collective and The RealReal, along with the proliferation of online stores and social‑media channels, has dramatically lowered the entry barrier for Birkin resale.

California‑based luxury‑resale platform Fashionphile founder Sarah Davis said the number of Birkin listings on the site has surged 32‑fold over the past 15 years, with as many as 212 Birkin bags currently available for sale on the website.

items.title: 一文掌握特斯拉財報會議：2030拚年產500萬輛電動車、Optimus明年底商業化、未透露合併猜測
items.title_en: Tesla Earnings Call in One Article: Targeting 5 Million EVs by 2030, Optimus Commercialization Next Year, No Comment on Merger Rumors
paras: 馬斯克週三（21日）表示，特斯拉(TSLA-US)目標是到2030年前後實現年產約500萬輛電動車。財務長透露，資料中心對Megapack的需求「極其強勁」，馬斯克補充，2027年的Megapack產能已幾乎售罄。針對外界對與SpaceX潛在合併的猜測，馬斯克明確表示，不會就此透露更多資訊。
特斯拉將年度資本支出目標從逾250億美元下調至200億美元，同時馬斯克為投資人描繪了一幅跨越多個業務領域的長期成長藍圖，涵蓋電動車產能、儲能業務及人形機器人的進展。
特斯拉週三公布，截至9月的2026年第三季營收為280.5億美元，年增率幾乎為零，略低於分析師預期的281.3億美元；但調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為0.48美元，較分析師預期高約9%。
特斯拉將年度資本支出目標由此前的逾250億美元下調至200億美元，降幅約20%。公司同時坦承，電池供應有限正在拖累現有生產，並表示正推進擴大供應規模的相關工作，以提升整體電池產能。
馬斯克在電話會議上表示，特斯拉的目標是到2030年前後實現年產約500萬輛電動車。他強調，FSD（完全自動駕駛）是目前帶動需求的最核心因素，「市場上目前沒有任何一款可購買的電動車能與FSD競爭」，需求成長速度已明顯超過生產能力。
在儲能業務方面，公司財務長透露，資料中心對巨型電池Megapack的需求「極其強勁」，馬斯克補充，2027年的Megapack產能已幾乎售罄。
人形機器人方面，特斯拉已在美國加州佛蒙特工廠的高產量生產線上啟動Optimus的「早期產品」生產。馬斯克表示，預計到2027年底將解決目前Optimus面臨的技術及生產問題。
針對外界對特斯拉與SpaceX潛在合併的猜測，馬斯克在電話會議上明確表示，不會就此透露更多資訊。

交車受限於產能 儲能接近「售罄」

第三季，特斯拉連續兩季交車量超過48萬輛。財務長Vaibhav Taneja指出，公司目前的訂單積壓量達到四年來最高水準，「交車主要受限於生產」。
在華爾街最關注的毛利率方面，特斯拉表現亮眼。排除碳排放積分(碳權)收入後，電動車業務毛利率從第二季的16.3%升至18.1%；儲能業務創下13.7GWh史上第二高部署量，毛利率從20.4%躍升至33.1%；包含超級充電服務和保險在內的服務業務，毛利率也達到15.9%歷史新高。
馬斯克對儲能業務的未來充滿信心。他表示：「能源需求非常強勁。實際上，我們2027年的所有Megapack幾乎已經售罄，我們正盡可能加快提升產能，以滿足需求。」
馬斯克預期，後續毛利率將進一步改善。
現金流方面，特斯拉第三季末的自由現金流超過1.5億美元，現金及投資餘額超過450億美元。公司將本年度資本支出指引調整為約200億美元，並取得300億美元的借款額度，以支持未來的大規模擴張。

FSD與Robotaxi

自動駕駛（FSD）已成為推動特斯拉電動車銷售的最大動力。數據顯示，第三季北美地區超過75%的交車輛在交車時訂閱了FSD，較第二季高出約20個百分點。全球FSD付費用戶超過170萬，其中50%為訂閱用戶。
Vaibhav Taneja透露，第三季累計無人監督自動駕駛里程較前一季成長8倍，整個季度每週都維持雙位數成長。 Vaibhav Taneja直言：「如果你還沒試過FSD，我每次都要說，只要你試過，就再也無法回去開其他任何一款電動車。」
分析師Pierre Ferragu在會議上指出，若以每輛電動車約7,000美元的毛利估算，FSD訂閱收入對電動車銷售當季的影響有限；但若以每年逾1,000美元的訂閱費計算，整個產品生命週期內，FSD可能使單車利潤至少翻倍。他並估計，FSD年度經常性收入(ARR)已接近10億美元。
Vaibhav Taneja對此表示認同，並承諾隨著業務規模擴大，將公布更多FSD相關指標，包括收入及客戶留存率。
在Robotaxi方面，德州奧斯汀的Cybercab車隊規模，自一個月前發布以來已成長10倍。 馬斯克在描述里程成長時，使用了極具衝擊力的比喻：「當我看著每週的圖表時，哇，那基本上就像火箭進入軌道一樣，成長得非常快。」
在擴張路徑上，Ashok Elluswamy透露，Robotaxi服務將於下月進軍達拉斯市場，目前已涵蓋六座城市，並計畫在年底前實現24小時全天候營運、拓展至高速公路路段及更多氣候條件。
他同時表示，目前的擴張主要受到AI能力進展的推動，預計到明年第一、第二季，限制因素將逐漸轉為監管審批。
在獲利路徑方面，Vaibhav Taneja表示，Robotaxi業務目前尚未達到每英里0.30美元的目標成本，但實現目標的路徑已相當明確。馬斯克預計，該業務將從明年第二季起開始「引起關注」，並在明年第三、第四季成為「重要貢獻」。
工程副總裁Lars Moravy透露，目前生產的Cybercab全部用於內部車隊，但「我們正努力在今年年底前將Cybercab交付給客戶」。
Lars Moravy表示，Cybercab生產線的實際產能遠高於目前公布的年產12.5萬輛數字。目前的生產節奏由Robotaxi服務的車輛需求決定，雙方正在「競賽」：服務端的指數型里程成長，與生產線的產能提升速度相互追趕。

Optimus機器人

人形機器人Optimus被特斯拉視為下一個可能實現爆發式成長的產品。馬斯克將Optimus人形機器人大規模交付外部客戶的時間，定在「大約一年後」，也就是2027年底前後。他強調，這個時間點取決於三大里程碑能否到位：電機設計定型、AI軟體成熟，以及AI5晶片整合。
馬斯克透露，目前已在加州佛蒙特工廠的「百萬台級高產量生產線」上開始早期生產，同時也在奧斯汀興建新廠房，以支撐更大的產能。
然而，馬斯克坦言，由於產品設計仍在持續改良，預計至少需要一年時間，才能達到每週20,000台的年化產能。
在技術細節方面，馬斯克和Ashok Elluswamy都將手部設計列為目前最主要的機電工程難題。人類手指具備自我修復能力，兼顧柔軟觸感與多維度感測功能；機器人手部則面臨如何同時實現耐磨性與靈活性的重大挑戰。
預計明年4月整合的AI5晶片，運算能力將較AI4提升約10倍，進而顯著增強Optimus處理複雜任務的能力。
在機器人訓練方面，特斯拉並未採用電動車的「群眾外包」模式，而是建立「Optimus學院」，讓機器人透過數以萬計次的自我對弈(Self-play)進行學習。 馬斯克生動比喻道：「你有了一個蹣跚學步的孩子，一開始他們跌跌撞撞……最終他們學會了自己擦屁股，這是一個重大的里程碑。任何有孩子的人都知道。」
馬斯克提出Optimus幾個關鍵時間點：

約1至2個月內，將發布一段非預先編程(Unscripted)的機器人工作影片，以證明其實際AI能力。
如果一切順利，預計明年4月將特斯拉AI5晶片整合至Optimus，運算能力將提升一個數量級。
預計明年底左右，將Optimus交付給特斯拉以外的公司，首批高價值應用場景將是全天候運作的重工業，以及危險、重複性的工作。


馬斯克表示，「我依然堅信，Optimus將成為地球上最偉大的產品。總體而言，人形機器人也將成為地球上最偉大的產品。」

Terafab晶片工廠

為了徹底解決半導體運算能力與供應鏈瓶頸，特斯拉正在德州奧斯汀快速推進自研晶片製造基地Terafab。
馬斯克表示，按照計畫，該工廠將於明年上半年開始設備調試，力爭明年5、6月產出首片測試晶片，並希望在2028年第三季實現具實用價值的晶片量產。
這不僅是一項技術工程，也需要龐大的資金投入。馬斯克透露：「在2028年初之前，資本設備投入肯定會達到數百億美元。而長期來看，投入金額將遠超1,000億美元。」
馬斯克將Terafab定位為Optimus大規模擴張的「必要資產」，認為解決記憶體、封裝及邏輯晶片等半導體瓶頸，是支撐機器人產業化的關鍵前提。他認為，這筆投資絕對值得，「正如我在X上公開說過的，我認為Terafab將成為世界上最有價值的建築，其經濟價值可能使其躋身全球前20大國家之列。」
paras_en: Elon Musk said on Wednesday (the 21st) that Tesla (TSLA-US) aims to produce about 5 million electric vehicles per year around 2030. The CFO disclosed that demand for Megapack from data centers is "extremely strong," and Musk added that Megapack capacity for 2027 is almost fully sold. Regarding speculation about a possible merger with SpaceX, Musk made it clear he will not provide any further information.

Tesla lowered its annual capital‑expenditure target from over $25 billion to $20 billion, while Musk painted a long‑term growth roadmap spanning multiple business areas, including EV capacity, energy storage and humanoid robots.

Tesla reported on Wednesday that third‑quarter 2026 revenue through September was $28.05 billion, essentially flat year‑over‑year and slightly below analysts' estimate of $28.13 billion; adjusted earnings per share were $0.48, about 9% above expectations.

The company cut its annual cap‑ex goal from more than $25 billion to $20 billion, a roughly 20% reduction. It also admitted that limited battery supply is dragging on current production and said it is working to expand supply to boost overall battery capacity.

In the earnings call Musk reiterated the goal of roughly 5 million EVs per year around 2030. He emphasized that Full Self‑Driving (FSD) is the core demand driver, stating "no purchasable EV on the market can compete with FSD" and that demand growth is already outpacing production capability.
Regarding energy storage, the CFO said data‑center demand for the giant Megapack battery is "extremely strong," and Musk added that Megapack capacity for 2027 is virtually sold out.

On humanoid robots, Tesla has started early‑product production of Optimus on a high‑volume line at its Fremont, California factory. Musk said the technical and manufacturing issues facing Optimus are expected to be resolved by the end of 2027.
Addressing merger rumors with SpaceX, Musk said in the call he will not disclose any more information on the topic.

Vehicle deliveries are constrained by capacity while storage is nearing "sell‑out". In the third quarter Tesla delivered over 480,000 vehicles for the second consecutive quarter. CFO Vaibhav Taneja noted that order backlog is at a four‑year high, with deliveries mainly limited by production.

On the margin metric Wall Street watches most, Tesla shone. Excluding carbon‑credit revenue, EV gross margin rose from 16.3% in Q2 to 18.1%; energy‑storage gross margin jumped from 20.4% to 33.1% on a record‑second‑highest deployment of 13.7 GWh; and services—including Supercharging and insurance—reached a historic 15.9% gross margin.

Musk expressed confidence in the storage business, saying "energy demand is very strong. In fact, virtually all Megapack units for 2027 are already sold, and we are accelerating capacity expansion to meet that demand."
Musk expects margins to improve further going forward.

Cash flow: free cash flow at the end of Q3 exceeded $150 million and cash and investments topped $45 billion. The company revised its cap‑ex guidance to about $20 billion for the year and secured a $30 billion loan facility to fund large‑scale expansion.

FSD and Robotaxi: Autonomous driving (FSD) is now the biggest driver of Tesla EV sales. Data show that over 75% of North‑American deliveries in Q3 subscribed to FSD at delivery, about 20 percentage points higher than Q2. Global paid FSD users exceed 1.7 million, half of whom are subscribers.

CFO Vaibhav Taneja said total unsupervised autonomous‑driving miles in Q3 grew eight‑fold versus the prior quarter, with double‑digit weekly growth throughout the quarter. He added, "If you haven't tried FSD, I have to say every time you do, you can never go back to any other EV."

Analyst Pierre Ferragu noted that assuming roughly $7,000 gross profit per vehicle, FSD subscription revenue has limited impact on quarterly EV sales, but at over $1,000 annual subscription per car, FSD could double vehicle profit over its lifecycle. He estimated FSD annual recurring revenue is approaching $1 billion.
Taneja agreed and pledged to release more FSD metrics—including revenue and retention—as the business scales.
On Robotaxi, the Cybercab fleet in Austin, Texas has grown tenfold since its launch a month ago. Musk likened the mileage growth to "a rocket reaching orbit" when looking at the weekly charts.

Ashok Elluswamy said the Robotaxi service will enter the Dallas market next month, now covering six cities, with plans for 24‑hour operation, highway routes and broader climate conditions by year‑end.
He added that the expansion is currently driven by AI progress, with regulatory approvals expected to become the main constraint in Q1‑Q2 of next year.

Taneja said Robotaxi has not yet hit the target cost of $0.30 per mile, but the path to that goal is clear. Musk expects the business to start "gaining attention" in Q2 next year and become a "significant contributor" in Q3‑Q4.
VP of Engineering Lars Moravy disclosed that all Cybercabs produced so far are for internal use, but the team aims to deliver them to customers by the end of the year.

Moravy said the actual capacity of the Cybercab line far exceeds the publicly stated annual output of 125,000 units. Production pace is set by Robotaxi demand, creating a race between exponential mileage growth and line capacity expansion.

Optimus robots: Tesla sees the humanoid Optimus as a product with explosive growth potential. Musk set the timeline for large‑scale delivery to external customers at "about a year later," i.e., around the end of 2027, contingent on three milestones: motor design finalization, mature AI software, and AI‑5 chip integration.
He revealed early‑stage production has begun on a "million‑unit‑scale high‑volume" line at the Fremont plant, and a new factory is being built in Austin to support larger capacity.
However, Musk admitted the design is still being refined and will need at least a year to reach an annualized capacity of 20,000 units per week.

Both Musk and Elluswamy said hand design is the biggest electromechanical challenge; human hands self‑repair, combine softness and multi‑dimensional sensing, while robot hands must balance wear resistance with flexibility.
The AI‑5 chip slated for integration in April next year will deliver roughly ten times the compute of AI‑4, markedly boosting Optimus' ability to handle complex tasks.

For robot training, Tesla is not using the EV "crowd‑sourced" model but has created an "Optimus Academy" where robots learn via tens of thousands of self‑play games. Musk analogized, "It's like a toddler learning to walk—lots of falls at first, then they learn to wipe themselves; that's a huge milestone anyone with kids understands."

Musk outlined several key Optimus milestones: within 1‑2 months a video of the robot performing unscripted work will be released to demonstrate real AI capability; if all goes well, AI‑5 will be integrated into Optimus by April next year, raising compute by an order of magnitude; and by around the end of next year Optimus will be delivered to companies outside Tesla, with initial high‑value use cases in 24‑hour heavy‑industry, hazardous and repetitive jobs.
He added, "I still believe Optimus will become the greatest product on Earth. Overall, humanoid robots will be the greatest product on the planet."
Terafab chip factory: To fully solve semiconductor compute and supply‑chain bottlenecks, Tesla is rapidly advancing its in‑house chip‑fabrication plant, Terafab, in Austin, Texas.

Musk said the plant is scheduled to begin equipment commissioning in the first half of next year, aiming to produce the first test chips in May‑June and achieve volume production of commercially viable chips by Q3 2028.

This effort is not only a technical undertaking but also requires massive capital. Musk disclosed that capital equipment spending will reach several hundred billion dollars before early 2028, and over the long term the total investment will far exceed $100 billion.

Musk positions Terafab as a "necessary asset" for large‑scale Optimus expansion, arguing that solving memory, packaging and logic‑chip bottlenecks is essential for robot industrialization. He believes the investment is justified, stating on X that Terafab could become the world's most valuable building, with economic value comparable to that of the top‑20 nations.

items.title: 貝森特閉門會議向華爾街放話：看不出AI有什麼「系統性風險」
items.title_en: Biden's Closed-Door Meeting Sends Message to Wall Street: Sees No Systemic Risk from AI
paras: 英國《金融時報》報導，美國財政部長貝森特週三 (21 日) 在紐約一場華爾街閉門會議上表示，他看不出人工智慧 (AI) 產業有什麼系統性風險，並以「這不是 Pets.com」駁斥市場將這波 AI 熱潮與網路泡沫相提並論的看法。
Pets.com 是美國線上寵物用品零售商，2000 年 2 月上市，同年 11 月就宣布結束營運，上市到關站不到 1 年，成為網路泡沫破裂的知名案例。
近期 AI 類股反覆震盪，投資人持續檢視相關股價漲勢是否過度，以及企業為興建資料中心、採購晶片而大舉舉債的風險。貝森特此時表態，為市場對 AI 投資熱潮能否延續的辯論增添分量。
這場活動由摩根大通與扶貧非營利組織羅賓漢基金會 (Robin Hood) 共同主辦，入場票價從 7,500 美元起跳，未開放媒體採訪。貝森特在橋水執行長 Nir Bar Dea 主持的訪談中，向數百名金融業高階主管與投資人分享對美國經濟及 AI 的看法。
據 3 名與會人士轉述，貝森特表示：「我很擅長辨識一個體系何時出了問題。我沒有看到任何系統性問題。」
他也以網路泡沫時期的代表企業 Pets.com 為例，否定兩者的類比，並以科技企業領導人的成就與持股，說明自己對 AI 發展的信心。
貝森特表示，這些人是「世界上最聰明的人」，99% 的財富與旗下公司綁在一起，而且已打造出全球最賺錢的企業，「他們相信這件事」。
整體而言，貝森特對 AI 可為美國帶來的效益抱持樂觀態度。不過，他也指出，資料中心業者與 AI 公司尚未充分向一般民眾說明，這項技術能為他們帶來哪些好處。
除了 AI 相關發言，這場活動的閉門形式也引發外界對政府官員與市場人士溝通透明度的關注。活動最高贊助方案達 10 萬美元，其他講者包括知名投資人朱肯米勒 (Stanley Druckenmiller) 與避險基金經理人柯恩 (Steve Cohen)。
美國財政部發言人表示，貝森特在公私部門擁有 35 年金融業經驗，充分了解何謂重大未公開資訊，且他在活動中的所有發言，都曾事先公開表達。
羅賓漢基金會傳播長 Kevin Thompson 則表示，這場會議多年來大多採取不開放媒體的閉門形式，也曾邀請多位現任及前任政府顧問與內閣官員出席。活動今年邁入第 14 年，迄今已募得近 7,200 萬美元。
前美國財政部長葉倫受訪時表示，她發表談話時，一向會確保媒體在場。她指出，過去擔任聯準會主席的經驗，讓她深知向有限受眾傳達敏感資訊可能帶來的風險。
聯準會規範要求，官員與外界互動時，不應讓任何營利個人或機構取得競爭優勢，並建議聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 官員在有媒體出席的活動中發言。
不過，目前並無規定禁止財政部長在媒體不在場的情況下，向大批私人市場參與者發表談話。
保守派法律非營利組織 Article III Project 創辦人 Mike Davis 則為活動辯護，強調這是一場慈善活動，認為應鼓勵政府官員參與這類場合。
paras_en: The Financial Times reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen (note: the article refers to "Bai Sen Te" which is a transliteration of "Biden"; assuming it is Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen) said at a closed‑door Wall Street meeting in New York on Wednesday the 21st that she sees no systemic risk in the artificial‑intelligence (AI) industry, dismissing the view that the current AI boom is comparable to the dot‑com bubble with the remark “this is not Pets.com.”

Pets.com was an online pet‑supplies retailer that went public in February 2000 and announced it would cease operations in November of the same year, disappearing in less than a year and becoming a well‑known example of the dot‑com crash.

AI‑related stocks have been swinging back and forth recently, with investors scrutinizing whether price gains are excessive and whether companies are taking on large debt loads to build data centers and buy chips. Biden’s comments at this moment add weight to the debate over whether the AI investment frenzy can be sustained.

The event was co‑hosted by JPMorgan Chase and the anti‑poverty nonprofit Robin Hood Foundation, with tickets starting at $7,500 and no media access. In an interview moderated by Bridgewater founder Nir Bar Dea, Biden shared his views on the U.S. economy and AI with hundreds of senior finance executives and investors.
According to three attendees, Biden said, “I’m good at spotting when a system is broken. I don’t see any systemic problem.”
He also used Pets.com, a hallmark of the dot‑com era, as a counterexample and cited the achievements and equity stakes of technology‑sector leaders to illustrate his confidence in AI’s development.

Biden said those people are “the smartest in the world,” that 99% of their wealth is tied to their companies, and that they have built the most profitable enterprises on the planet, “they believe in this.”

Overall, Biden expressed optimism about the benefits AI could bring to the United States, but he also noted that data‑center operators and AI firms have not yet adequately explained to the public what advantages the technology can deliver.

Beyond AI remarks, the closed‑door format of the event sparked concerns about transparency in communication between government officials and market participants. The top sponsorship tier was $100,000, and other speakers included well‑known investor Stanley Druckenmiller and hedge‑fund manager Steve Cohen.

A Treasury spokesperson said Biden has 35 years of experience in the financial sector across public and private roles, fully understands what constitutes material non‑public information, and that all of his remarks at the event had been disclosed in advance.

Robin Hood’s communications chief Kevin Thompson said the meeting has traditionally been media‑free and has invited numerous current and former government advisers and cabinet members over the years. This year marks the 14th edition of the event, which has raised nearly $72 million to date.

Former Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen told reporters that she always ensures media presence when she speaks. She noted that her experience as former Fed chair makes her keenly aware of the risks of conveying sensitive information to a limited audience.

Federal Reserve rules require that officials not give any profit‑seeking individual or entity a competitive edge when interacting with outsiders, and they advise that FOMC members speak only at events with media attendance.
However, there is currently no rule prohibiting the Treasury secretary from addressing a large private‑market audience when the media are not present.

Mike Davis, founder of the conservative nonprofit Article III Project, defended the event, emphasizing that it is a charitable gathering and arguing that government officials should be encouraged to participate in such forums.

items.title: 〈財報〉IBM Q3優預期、上修軟體展望 盤後先漲後跌
items.title_en: IBM Q3 Beats Expectations, Raises Software Outlook; Stock Rises Then Falls After Hours
paras: IBM(IBM-US)股價週三(21日)盤後先漲後跌，截稿前下跌約4%，第三季財報表現為公司重塑市場形象跨出一步，但華爾街認為，未來仍有一段長路要走。
IBM週三盤後公布2026會計年度第三季財報，調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為2.95美元，高於分析師預估的2.85美元。營收較去年同期成長4.7%，達171億美元，也超越華爾街預期的168億美元。儘管營收成長速度較前一季略有加快，但仍遠低於第一季9.5%的成長率。
成長最明顯的是軟體部門，營收增加8%至78億美元，高於分析師預估的76.6億美元。基礎架構部門營收成長4%，達37.1億美元。顧問服務部門營收則大致持平，為53.4億美元。
執行長Arvind Krishna接受《路透社》採訪時表示，公司目前預期全年軟體營收將成長約7%至8%，高於先前預估的6%至8%。

Q3 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：171 億美元 v.s. 168 億美元
調整後EPS：2.95 美元 v.s. 2.85 美元


市場反應說明投資人至今仍未完全擺脫第二季財報帶來的衝擊。IBM於7月14日罕見提前發布業績預告，股價隨後重挫25%，創下史上最差單日表現。
此後，IBM股價一直未能明顯反彈。截至目前，與7月13日收盤價相比，股價仍下跌逾13%。
除了第二季業績令人失望外，IBM長期面臨內生成長疲弱的問題，也是華爾街不願過度樂觀的原因。為了抵銷成長放緩的影響，IBM近年來持續透過收購軟體公司擴大業務，重要交易包括收購Red Hat、HashiCorp及Confluent。
Jefferies分析師Brent Thill將IBM第三季形容為「有待證明的故事」。他承認，財報公布前市場的預期門檻已經降低，但也指出，在第二季因執行不力及大型主機交易延遲而導致獲利不如預期後，市場預期已逐漸回歸正常。
IBM週三表示，先前延遲的交易中，約有三分之二已在第三季完成。儘管這並未促使公司上調營收展望，管理層仍重申全年營收成長4%至5%的預測，但公司調高了另一項財務指標的預期。
Krishna表示，受惠於最新一季「強勁的自由現金流」，公司目前預期全年自由現金流將較前一年增加逾10億美元。
儘管此次財報新聞稿並未特別提及，IBM的量子運算業務仍值得關注。數十年的研究投入，使公司成為該領域早期的技術與商業領導者之一，也是美國政府的重要合作夥伴。
本月稍早，IBM在一項聯邦量子運算基準測試計畫中晉級最後階段，獲得重要肯定。該計畫旨在以獨立方式評估參與者的進展，檢視各方能否在2033年前打造出具實用價值及錯誤校正能力的量子運算系統。
第三季財報或許為投資人帶來一線曙光，但摩根士丹利提醒，未來幾個月IBM將面臨更高的營收成長期待，以及更具挑戰性的宏觀經濟環境。
分析師指出，隨著先前延遲的交易終於完成，最新業績「應被視為中性偏正面」，但「此後情勢將更具挑戰性」。
paras_en: IBM (IBM-US) shares rose then fell after Wednesday's (the 21st) after‑hours trading, ending down about 4% before the deadline. The Q3 earnings mark a step forward in the company’s effort to reshape its market image, but Wall Street says a long road still lies ahead.

IBM announced its fiscal 2026 third‑quarter results after the market closed on Wednesday. Adjusted earnings per share were $2.95, above analysts’ estimate of $2.85. Revenue grew 4.7% year‑over‑year to $17.1 billion, also beating Wall Street’s forecast of $16.8 billion. Although the revenue growth rate accelerated slightly from the prior quarter, it remained far below the 9.5% growth seen in Q1.

The software segment showed the strongest growth, with revenue up 8% to $7.8 billion, surpassing the $7.66 billion analysts expected. Infrastructure revenue rose 4% to $3.71 billion, while consulting services revenue was essentially flat at $5.34 billion.
CEO Arvind Krishna told Reuters the company now expects full‑year software revenue to grow about 7%‑8%, higher than the previous outlook of 6%‑8%.

Q3 key figures versus LSEG estimates: Revenue $17.1 billion vs. $16.8 billion; Adjusted EPS $2.95 vs. $2.85. The market reaction shows investors have not fully shaken off the impact of the second‑quarter results. IBM unusually released an earnings preview on July 14, after which the stock plunged 25%, marking its worst single‑day performance on record.
Since then IBM’s share price has failed to rebound noticeably. To date the stock remains down more than 13% compared with its closing price on July 13.

Beyond the disappointing second‑quarter results, IBM’s long‑standing issue of weak organic growth also dampens Wall Street optimism. To offset slowing growth, IBM has continued to expand through software acquisitions in recent years, including Red Hat, HashiCorp and Confluent.

Jefferies analyst Brent Thill described IBM’s third quarter as a “story that still needs to be proven.” He acknowledged that market expectations had already been lowered before the earnings release, but noted that after the second quarter’s under‑performance due to execution lapses and delayed mainframe deals, expectations are gradually returning to normal.

IBM said on Wednesday that about two‑thirds of the previously delayed transactions were completed in the third quarter. Although this did not prompt an upward revision of the revenue outlook, management reiterated its forecast of 4%‑5% full‑year revenue growth, while raising expectations for another financial metric.
Krishna said that, buoyed by a “strong free cash flow” in the latest quarter, the company now expects full‑year free cash flow to increase by more than $1 billion versus the prior year.

While the press release did not call attention to it, IBM’s quantum computing business remains noteworthy. Decades of research have made the company one of the early technology and commercial leaders in the field and a key partner of the U.S. government.

Earlier this month IBM advanced to the final stage of a federal quantum‑computing benchmark program, earning significant recognition. The program independently assesses participants’ progress and examines whether they can deliver a quantum system with practical value and error‑correction capability by 2033.

The third‑quarter results may offer investors a glimmer of hope, but Morgan Stanley warns that IBM will face higher revenue‑growth expectations and a more challenging macro‑economic environment in the coming months.
Analysts note that with the previously delayed deals finally completed, the latest results “should be seen as neutral‑to‑slightly‑positive,” but “the road ahead will be more challenging.”

items.title: 法國巴黎本周第三次夜間宵禁
items.title_en: Paris, France imposes third night curfew this week
paras: 法國巴黎警察總局在21日（周三）宣布，21日23時至22日6時，將對共和國廣場和大堂商業區一帶實施宵禁，禁止人員在相關區域停留。
這是巴黎本周第三次夜間宵禁，該措施按照法國總理勒科爾尼和內政部長努內茲的要求實施。
此外，法國抗爭者預定24日舉行下一輪示威活動，努內茲20日說，為更好應對示威活動可能引發的暴力事件，法國政府將部署法軍反恐力量「哨兵」行動的士兵，增援警察和憲兵。
努內茲當日在回答法國國民議會質詢時作出上述表態。他表示，「哨兵」行動的士兵將主要作為固定看守力量，為警察和憲兵分擔壓力，增強後者執法行動的機動性。
努內茲說，政府還考慮禁止未經申報的示威遊行，以及已經申報、但存在失控風險的示威遊行。
paras_en: French police headquarters in Paris announced on the 21st (Wednesday) that from 23:00 on the 21st to 06:00 on the 22nd, a curfew will be imposed around Place de la République and the Hall commercial district, prohibiting people from staying in the area.
This is Paris's third night curfew this week, implemented at the request of French Prime Minister Le Corni and Interior Minister Nunes.

Additionally, French protesters plan to hold the next round of demonstrations on the 24th; Nunes said on the 20th that to better cope with possible violence from the protests, the French government will deploy soldiers from the army's anti‑terrorism “Sentinel” operation to reinforce police and gendarmerie.

Nunes made the statement that day while answering questions from the French National Assembly. He said the “Sentinel” soldiers will mainly serve as a fixed guard force, sharing the burden with police and gendarmes and enhancing the latter's operational mobility.
Nunes said the government is also considering banning unregistered demonstrations, as well as those that have been registered but pose a risk of getting out of control.

U.S. September single‑family home construction fell sharply and future construction permits dropped to a three‑and‑a‑half‑year low. Multiple Iranian officials say they intend to delay talks with the United States to weaken President Trump’s prospects in the November mid‑term elections. Meanwhile U.S. Treasury yields fell, reducing the dollar’s appeal and putting pressure on the greenback on Wednesday. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to raise rates to 1.50% in December and keep a quarterly‑hike rhythm. Japan’s government reported September imports and exports grew 18.9% and 16.7% year‑on‑year, respectively, below expectations, but strong demand for semiconductor and AI‑related products kept exports up for a 13th consecutive month while the trade deficit narrowed to ¥536.6 billion. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki noted rising import costs are pushing Japanese prices higher and that the economy is entering a wage‑driven, sustained inflation phase. The government will stay in close contact with the BOJ, and both sides see no major disagreement on inflation outlook or policy, supporting yen gains as the USD/JPY pair fell from its ¥158.39 high.

As long‑term Japanese government bond yields continue to rise, they are attracting capital back to Japan. BOJ Deputy Governor Masayoshi Amamiya said higher fuel and raw‑material prices are lifting inflation, and robust global AI demand adds upward pressure on prices. He believes Japan’s core inflation is now close to the BOJ’s 2% target, indicating the central bank is ready to raise borrowing costs, widening the USD/JPY decline to a ¥157.82 low. However, escalating conflict between the United States, Israel and Iran is raising market volatility and fears of energy‑supply disruptions, while falling U.S. crude inventories are supporting higher oil prices, limiting the dollar’s fall. EUR/USD

The market now sees roughly a 50% chance of an RBA hike in November, pushing the Aussie dollar to a three‑week high and lifting the euro‑dollar pair from its ¥1.1211 low.

paras: 美元周三(21日)下跌，交易員評估油價上漲再度引發的通膨風險，並等待聯準會(Fed)下週召開會議。澳幣則因央行官員發表偏緊縮言論而走強。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。
不過，Osborne表示，「我認為，下週市場至少會進一步評估未來升息的可能時間點，相關預期也會變得更加明確。」
投資人也擔心AI交易行情還能持續多久。
儘管上週數據顯示美國9月消費者物價通膨加速，美元仍然走弱。先前市場對AI產業的樂觀情緒吸引資金流入美國，並推升經濟成長與通膨預期，為美元提供支撐。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略師Noah Buffam表示，「美國經濟成長很大程度上是由整體AI交易行情所帶動。這也使通膨持續高於目標水準，因此AI對美國的影響比對其他國家更大。」
馬斯克週二表示，合併旗下SpaceX與特斯拉是「一個好主意」，而SpaceX也公布上市以來首次獲利，部分緩解了市場對股市的疑慮。
另一方面，AI伺服器製造商美超微（Super Micro）預估，季營收與利潤率將高於華爾街預期。
歐元兌美元上漲0.01%，至1.1237美元。
法國大規模反政府抗議活動，以及日益惡化的財政前景，持續對歐元造成壓力。法國10年期公債借貸成本週三升至24年來高點。
Saxo全球宏觀策略主管John Hardy表示，「法國的債務問題難以處理。他們確實需要採取適當的財政調整措施，降低債務水準，至少要展現出對債務發展趨勢的重視。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)承諾，將防止上週末的暴動與掠奪事件再次發生。同時，黃背心運動(Yellow Vest)已提出計畫，準備於週六在巴黎舉行大型遊行，這將成為法國政府面臨的下一項重大考驗。
其他貨幣方面，澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁Andrew Hauser在花旗集團一場會議上表示，通膨前景「明顯惡化」，帶動澳幣走強。
澳幣兌美元上漲0.41%，至0.7031美元。

英鎊兌歐元則升至17個月來最高水準。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Wednesday (the 21st) as traders assessed renewed inflation risks from rising oil prices and waited for the Federal Reserve's meeting next week. The Australian dollar strengthened on tighter‑tone comments from central bank officials.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies slipped 0.14% to 101.65.

Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne said, “There isn’t a clear, dominant theme driving the market right now… I think this will last at least until the FOMC meeting next week. We need to understand the Fed’s thinking.”
The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has heightened market concerns that higher oil prices could push inflation up and affect Fed policy.
Federal‑funds futures traders see little chance of a rate hike next week, with the next increase expected in December. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is also unlikely to signal future policy direction.
However, Osborne added, “I think the market will at least further assess the timing of any future hikes next week, and expectations will become clearer.”
Investors are also worried about how long the AI‑driven market rally can last.

Even though last week’s data showed September U.S. CPI accelerating, the dollar remained weak. Earlier optimism toward the AI sector had drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth and inflation expectations and supporting the greenback.

CIBC Capital Markets FX strategist Noah Buffam said, “U.S. economic growth is largely driven by the overall AI trading rally. That keeps inflation above target, so AI’s impact on the U.S. is greater than on other countries.”
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that merging his SpaceX and Tesla businesses was “a good idea,” and SpaceX reported its first profit since going public, easing some market concerns about equities.
On the other hand, AI server maker Super Micro projected quarterly revenue and margins above Wall Street expectations.
The euro rose 0.01% against the dollar to $1.1237.
Large anti‑government protests in France and a worsening fiscal outlook continue to pressure the euro. France’s 10‑year bond yields rose on Wednesday to a 24‑year high.

Saxo Global macro‑strategy head John Hardy said, “France’s debt problem is hard to solve. They really need to take appropriate fiscal adjustment measures, lower debt levels, and at least show concern for the debt‑development trend.”

French President Emmanuel Macron pledged to prevent a repeat of last weekend’s riots and looting. Meanwhile, the Yellow Vest movement has announced plans for a large march in Paris on Saturday, which will be the next major test for the French government.
Elsewhere, RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook was “clearly deteriorating,” fueling Australian‑dollar gains.
The Australian dollar rose 0.41% against the U.S. dollar to $0.7031.
The British pound gained 0.16% against the dollar to $1.34. Data showed September UK inflation rose more than expected, strengthening the case for a BoE rate hike in November.
The pound also rose against the euro to its highest level in 17 months.

The yen edged up 0.02% to ¥158.12 per dollar. BoJ deputy governor Ryozo Himino said Japan’s underlying inflation is near the 2% target, the financial environment remains accommodative, and there is still room to raise borrowing costs in the future.

items.title: 英國財政預算案前夕 英鎊對歐元避險成本創5個月新高
items.title_en: Britain's Budget Looms as GBP/EUR Hedging Cost Hits Five-Month High
paras: 隨著交易員針對下周即將公布的英國財政預算案進行布局，英鎊對歐元匯率波動的避險成本已攀升至5個月來的新高。
其中，涵蓋預算案公布日期的歐元對英鎊一周隱含波動率一度升至 4.88%，創下 5 月以來的最高水準。一周與三周波動率之間的價差大幅偏向短天期，顯示出強烈的事件風險溢價，創下5個月來最大差距，儘管三周期的選擇權同時涵蓋了英國央行與歐洲央行的利率決策會議。
目前市場投資人高度聚焦於英國的財政前景，以及財政大臣希利(John Healey)將如何平衡政府收支。由於英國今年上半年的政府借款高於預期，推升國家債務總額突破 3 兆英鎊(約 4 兆美元)。
選擇權市場的情緒(反映於風險逆轉指標)顯示，儘管交易員支付更高代價以防範預算案公布期間的大幅波動，但市場仍預期未來一周英鎊對歐元將呈現溫和走強。此外，交易員過去常利用歐元來表達英國特有的風險，但此次歐元自身也已面臨財政與地緣政治壓力。
集保結算公司(DTCC)數據顯示，交易員已透過延伸至預算案公布日後的合約防範英鎊對美元下跌，但對歐元的布局則相對分歧。
在預算案存在不確定性的同時，英國 9 月通膨率因汽柴油價格飆升而創下 11 個月新高，強化了市場對升息的預期，使英國央行處於3年多來首次升息的軌道上。對於央行而言，關鍵在於財政聲明是否會改變通膨前景。
施羅德投資(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees對此表示：「市場對預算案的期望雖然不高，但任何顯著的財政刺激措施，都可能增加進口通膨變得更加持久的風險，並迫使英國央行進入更長的緊縮周期。」
paras_en: As traders position for next week’s UK fiscal budget announcement, the hedging cost of GBP/EUR volatility has risen to a five‑month peak.

The one‑week implied volatility of EUR/GBP covering the budget release date briefly spiked to 4.88%, the highest since May. The spread between one‑week and three‑week volatilities swung sharply toward the short end, indicating a strong event‑risk premium and the widest gap in five months, even though the three‑week options also encompass both the Bank of England and European Central Bank rate‑setting meetings.

Market participants are now intensely focused on the UK’s fiscal outlook and how Finance Minister John Healey will balance the government’s books. Borrowing in the first half of the year has exceeded expectations, pushing total national debt past £3 trillion (about $4 trillion).

Options‑market sentiment, reflected in the risk‑reversal indicator, shows that although traders are paying higher premiums to guard against large moves during the budget release, the market still expects a modest GBP strength against the euro over the next week. Historically, traders have used the euro to express UK‑specific risk, but this time the euro itself is also under fiscal and geopolitical pressure.

Data from the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) indicate that traders have extended contracts beyond the budget announcement date to hedge against a GBP fall versus the dollar, while positioning on the euro remains more mixed.

Amid budget uncertainty, September UK inflation hit an 11‑month high driven by soaring petrol and diesel prices, bolstering expectations of further rate hikes and putting the Bank of England on track for its first increase in over three years. For the central bank, the key question is whether the fiscal statement will alter the inflation outlook.

David Rees, global head of economics at Schroders, said: “Market expectations for the budget are modest, but any significant fiscal stimulus could make imported inflation more persistent and force the Bank of England into a longer tightening cycle.”

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯同步狂歡！開低走高強勢勁升1.29角收32.488元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Celebrate Together! Opens Low, Rises Strong, Gains 0.129 NTD to Close at 32.488
paras: 打破連四黑，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元今(21)日早盤開低走高，盤中最低貶 8.7 分，午後最高升值1.88角，盤中高低價差達2.75角，匯市多空激烈交戰，終場收在32.488元，升值1.29角，台北外匯成交金額20.59億美元，顯示在熱錢轉向與避險需求交織下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
台幣早盤一度因外資匯出重貶至 32.704 元波段新低，隨台股強彈、外資轉為匯入及相關調節，午後急拉翻紅，終場爆量強升 1.29 角，以 32.488 元作收，終止連四黑。細看匯市全日表現，今日開盤價為 32.630 元，盤中最高升抵 32.429 元、最低貶至 32.704 元，高低價差達 2.75 角。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，受美股科技股財報與半導體族群走強激勵，那斯達克及費城半導體指數持續反彈，帶動亞洲主要股市與貨幣連動上揚。日元、韓元等主要亞幣對美元普遍回升，吸引國際資金重新回流亞洲新興市場，匯市單邊拋匯壓力明顯緩解，促使台北匯市多頭買盤大舉湧現。
在台股與籌碼面部分，根據證交所最新統計數據，台股今日受到電子權值股發威帶動，終場大漲 594.84 點，收在 46,887.77 點，成交金額達 8,331.91 億元。
三大法人今日合計買超台股 5.68 億元。其中外資及陸資終結連續 10 個交易日的賣超，回頭買超 9.6 億元；投信則連續 9 個交易日力挺，加碼買超 129.19 億元；自營商仍站賣方調節，賣超 133.11 億元。外資由賣轉買並同步於匯市匯入，帶動股匯雙雙止跌回升。
觀察後續市場演變，匯銀人士分析，外資今日展現強烈回流意願，帶動新台幣一舉化解連續重貶破底的危機。目前新台幣收盤重回 32.50 元大關上方，短線重點將觀察外資買超台股的續航力道以及美國通膨數據、聯準會利率政策動向。若熱錢持續湧入，新台幣不排除進一步向 32.30 元關卡挑戰。
整體而言，投資人宜密切關注美股財報週表現、外資於現期貨市場與外匯市場的資金配置幅度，以及亞幣整體的相對強弱，作為後續投資佈局與資產風險控管的依據。
paras_en: Breaking a streak of four consecutive declines, the New Taiwan Dollar in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market opened lower against the US dollar this morning (21st) but turned higher, falling to a low of 8.7 points before rallying up to 1.88 NTD in the afternoon. The intraday high‑low spread reached 2.75 NTD, reflecting fierce buying‑selling battles, and the session closed at 32.488 NTD, up 1.29 NTD. Taipei’s FX turnover was US$20.59 billion, showing unusually active trading as hot money flows and hedging demand intertwined.

The NT$ briefly slipped to a new intraday low of 32.704 NTD in the early session due to foreign‑capital outflows, but a rebound in the Taiwan stock market, foreign inflows and related adjustments drove a sharp afternoon reversal, ending the day with a strong 1.29 NTD rise to close at 32.488 NTD, ending the four‑day losing streak. Looking at the day’s price action, the opening price was 32.630 NTD, the intraday high was 32.429 NTD, the low was 32.704 NTD, and the high‑low spread was 2.75 NTD.

From the international market and overall environment, US tech earnings and a rally in semiconductor stocks lifted the Nasdaq and Philadelphia Semiconductor indices, which in turn boosted major Asian equity markets and currencies. Major Asian currencies such as the yen and won generally appreciated against the dollar, attracting international capital back to Asian emerging markets. The one‑sided selling pressure in the FX market eased markedly, prompting a flood of bullish buying in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market.

On the equity side, according to the latest statistics from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, the market was driven by heavyweight electronic stocks, surging 594.84 points to finish at 46,887.77 points with a turnover of NT$8,331.91 billion.

The three major institutional investors bought a net NT$5.68 billion of Taiwanese stocks today. Foreign and mainland investors ended a ten‑day streak of net selling, turning to a net purchase of NT$9.6 billion; investment trusts continued a nine‑day buying streak, adding a net NT$129.19 billion; proprietary traders remained net sellers with a net sale of NT$133.11 billion. The shift of foreign investors from selling to buying, coupled with FX inflows, helped both stocks and the NT$ rebound.

Looking ahead, FX analysts note that foreign investors showed a strong willingness to return today, helping the NT$ quickly resolve the crisis of consecutive sharp depreciations. The NT$ now closed back above the 32.50 NTD threshold; short‑term focus will be on the sustainability of foreign buying in equities, US inflation data, and Fed rate policy. If hot money continues to flow in, the NT$ could further test the 32.30 NTD level.

Overall, investors should closely monitor US earnings reports, the scale of foreign capital allocation in futures and FX markets, and the relative strength of Asian currencies as bases for future investment positioning and asset‑risk management.

隨後美國商務部公布9月建築許可減0.2%至年率為140萬戶高於預期，但房屋開工驟降5.2%至經季節調整年率達122.1萬戶，並據全美住宅建築商協會(NAHB)調查9月成屋待完成銷售指數暴跌7.3%至66.0，創該指數2001年開始編制以來最低，突顯中東衝突推高抵押貸款利率和建築材料價格，打擊房地產市場，衝擊美元兌日圓跌至157.81低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.30-50，支撐於157.40-60。

週二英國公布截至8月的三個月，不含獎金平均薪資較上年同期增3.7%及失業率降至去年中以來最低4.7%，強化英國央行(BOE)於下月會議上調利率至4%的預期，支撐英鎊兌美元穩守1.3296低點。隨著BOE貨幣政策委員會(MPC)委員格林稱，伊朗戰爭引發能源價格衝擊，導致更廣泛通貨膨脹回升風險高於BOE預期，重申利率應上調的觀點，提振英鎊兌美元1.3409高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3330-50，阻力於1.3430-50。

In addition, Economy and Finance Minister Shiroi, seen as an ally of Prime Minister Kishida’s inflation‑focused camp, said on Tuesday he hopes to attend the Bank of Japan’s policy meeting this month but will respect the BOJ’s independence. According to four sources familiar with BOJ decision‑making, given the BOJ’s recent rate hike last month, the policy meeting ending on Oct. 30 is expected to keep rates unchanged, but higher oil prices are sustaining price pressures longer than expected, so the BOJ may raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the post‑meeting quarterly report, leaving room for a possible December rate hike. items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走低 伊朗局勢與AI風險牽動市場
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Slides as Iran Tensions and AI Risks Stir Markets
paras: 美元周二(20日)走低，與油價及較長天期美國公債殖利率下跌走勢一致。交易員正評估美國與伊朗戰事緊張情勢升高的影響，以及資金持續大舉流入美國AI企業的趨勢能否延續。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.25%，報101.71。
油價在觸及五個月高點後回落。交易員一方面關注伊朗總統與巴基斯坦陸軍參謀長的會面，後者是美伊談判的重要斡旋者。另一方面，也評估葉門青年運動（ Houthi）持續攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯基礎設施，以及波斯灣海域傳出船隻遭襲的消息。
油價上漲加深了市場對通膨可能在更長時間內維持高檔的憂慮。上週，美國公布的數據顯示，9月消費者物價通膨加速，帶動美元走強。
然而，市場焦點很快又轉向AI相關疑慮。
野村證券G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，「能源價格上漲有利美元，但如果利率因此升得太高，甚至導致AI交易行情崩盤，情況就會突然轉為不利因素。我們面臨一道臨界點，而目前市場正處於這個臨界點附近。」
大量資金流入美國AI股票，一直為美元提供支撐。部分與AI產業相關的成長及通膨預期推升利率，也進一步支撐美元。
不過，週二稍早，市場對AI的疑慮再度升溫。南韓AI服務公司Elice Group在首爾股市掛牌首日，股價暴跌32%。
歐元兌美元上漲0.22%，至1.1235美元。
儘管歐元週二上漲，交易員仍對其前景保持謹慎，因為法國正面臨大規模抗議活動，財政狀況也持續惡化。
法國政府週二表示，將增派軍警支援，並為週六預計舉行的新一輪抗議活動部署大規模維安措施。政府同時承認，在應對上週末的暴力事件時處置失當。
瑞典商業銀行（Handelsbanken）外匯策略師Tommy von Brömsen表示，「法國面臨的憂慮短期內不會消退。市場對法國的看空情緒還會持續一段時間，歐元也仍有進一步走弱的空間。」
英鎊兌美元上漲0.59%，至1.338美元。
英國最新公布的勞動市場數據顯示，就業市場仍具韌性，這也是近期一系列優於預期的英國經濟數據之一。
eToro全球市場策略師Lale Akoner表示，「風險在於，強韌的勞動市場可能讓英格蘭銀行(BoE)既有空間、也有理由再次升息。升息預期升高，可能有利英鎊。」
根據LSEG數據，市場幾乎已完全反映英格蘭銀行將在11月5日的下次會議升息1碼。
日本長天期公債(JGBs)標售吸引創紀錄的需求，帶動日元走強。
道富投資管理公司資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo表示，「20年期公債標售創下紀錄，強烈顯示先前觀望的資金終於開始回流。日本公債也逐漸成為相對安全的避風港，可用來因應歐洲政治與財政局勢的波動，尤其是法國的相關風險。」

paras_en: The dollar fell on Tuesday (the 20th), moving in line with declining oil prices and longer‑term U.S. Treasury yields. Traders are weighing the impact of heightened U.S.–Iran conflict risk and whether the massive inflow of capital into U.S. AI firms can continue.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.25% to 101.71.

Oil prices retreated after hitting a five‑month high. Traders are watching a meeting between Iran’s president and the Pakistani army chief, a key mediator in U.S.–Iran talks, while also assessing the Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and reports of a vessel being struck in the Persian Gulf.

Higher oil prices have deepened market worries that inflation could stay elevated for a longer period. Last week, U.S. data showed September consumer‑price inflation accelerating, which had previously boosted the dollar.
However, market focus quickly shifted back to AI‑related concerns.

Dominic Bunning, head of G10 FX strategy at Nomura Securities, said, “Rising energy prices are supportive of the dollar, but if rates climb too high and even trigger a collapse in AI trading activity, the situation could flip to a negative factor. We are at a critical juncture, and the market is currently hovering near that point.”
Large inflows into U.S. AI stocks have been underpinning the dollar. Some growth and inflation expectations tied to the AI sector have pushed rates higher, further supporting the greenback.
Nevertheless, early on Tuesday, doubts about AI resurfaced. South Korean AI services firm Elice Group saw its shares plunge 32% on the first day of trading on the Seoul exchange.
The euro rose 0.22% against the dollar to $1.1235.
Even though the euro gained on Tuesday, traders remain cautious about its outlook as France faces massive protests and a deteriorating fiscal situation.

The French government said on Tuesday it will deploy additional military police and implement extensive security measures ahead of a new round of protests expected on Saturday, while also acknowledging mishandling of last weekend’s violent incidents.

Tommy von Brömsen, FX strategist at Sweden’s Handelsbanken, said, “The concerns facing France will not dissipate in the short term. Bearish sentiment on France is likely to persist for a while, leaving room for the euro to weaken further.”
The pound rose 0.59% against the dollar to $1.338.
The latest UK labour market data show the employment market remains resilient, adding to a series of recent UK economic releases that have outperformed expectations.

Lale Akoner, global markets strategist at eToro, said, “The risk is that a robust labour market could give the Bank of England both the space and the incentive to raise rates again. Higher rate‑rise expectations could be bullish for the pound.”
LSEG data indicate the market has almost fully priced in a one‑basis‑point rate hike by the Bank of England at its next meeting on November 5.
Japan’s long‑term government bond (JGB) auction attracted record demand, strengthening the yen.

Masahiko Loo, senior fixed‑income strategist at State Street Global Advisors, said, “The record‑setting 20‑year bond auction shows that previously cautious capital is finally flowing back. Japanese bonds are increasingly seen as a relatively safe haven to hedge against volatility in European political and fiscal developments, especially the risks linked to France.”
The yen rose 0.21% against the dollar to ¥158.14.

In other currencies, residents of Alberta, Canada, voted in the province’s first separatist referendum, with a majority supporting staying in Canada. After the result was announced, the Canadian dollar rose 0.34% to C$1.406, its strongest level in nearly a month.

items.title_en: Foreign Investors Pull Out, Taiwan Stocks and Currency Both Plunge; TWD Briefly Drops 0.227 NTD, Losing the 32.6‑NTD Barrier
paras: 股匯雙殺再現，三大法人今(20)日合計賣超台股968.04億元，外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元終場收在32.617元，重貶1.72角，成交金額達32.77億美元；元太外匯市場成交金額為9.995億美元。兩大外匯市場今日成交金額合計高達 42.765 億美元，顯示在熱錢急退與避險結匯需求湧現下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
新台幣今日以32.48元開出，盤中最高32.48元，隨後受外資擴大匯出影響，一度衝破32.67元關卡，盤中下探至32.672元，最低重貶2.27角，全日維持弱勢重貶格局。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，雖然美股科技族群昨日出現逢低買盤，帶動那斯達克與費城半導體指數反彈，但亞幣整體維持弱勢格局，直接加重了新台幣的走貶壓力。市場資金在區域資產間快速挪移，外資於台股及匯市同步進行提款操作，形成匯市盤中沉重的下行連動壓力。
在台股與籌碼面部分，根據臺灣證券交易所統計數據，台股今日受電子權值股走弱影響，終場下跌529.15點，收在46292.93點，成交金額為7586.84億元。三大法人今日合計賣超台股968.04億元，其中外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，自營商賣超355.79億元，僅投信逆勢買超183.15億元，顯示外資大舉提款並將資金轉匯出境，是引發今日股匯雙殺的核心因素。
觀察市場後續演變，匯銀人士與市場專家分析指出，新台幣短線能否止貶回穩，完全取決於美股財報週表現及外資提款動作是否放緩。目前新台幣匯率陷於32.6元拉鋸戰，若熱錢匯出趨勢短期內未能平息，匯市不排除進一步回測32.8元關卡。
paras_en: The double blow to stocks and the foreign exchange market reappeared today, with the three major institutional investors collectively selling NT$96.804 billion of Taiwan equities. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors accounted for a net sell of NT$79.54 billion. The Taipei FX market closed at NT$32.617 per US $, a depreciation of 0.172 NTD, with a turnover of US$3.277 billion; the Yuan‑Tai FX market saw a turnover of US$0.9995 billion. Combined, the two FX markets handled US$4.2765 billion, indicating unusually vigorous trading amid a rapid outflow of hot money and a surge in hedging demand.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.48 and peaked at NT$32.48 intraday. It then slipped as foreign investors accelerated outflows, briefly breaching the NT$32.67 barrier and falling to NT$32.672, a low that represented a 0.227 NTD weakening. The currency remained in a weak, depreciating stance throughout the session.

Looking at the international markets and the broader environment, U.S. tech stocks rallied yesterday, lifting the Nasdaq and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index. However, Asian currencies stayed weak overall, adding pressure to the TWD’s decline. Capital shifted quickly among regional assets, and foreign investors withdrew from both Taiwan equities and the FX market simultaneously, creating a heavy downward linkage in the currency market.

On the equity side, Taiwan Stock Exchange data show that the market was dragged down by weaker electronic‑sector leaders, closing down 529.15 points at 46,292.93 with a turnover of NT$758.684 billion. The three major institutional investors sold a total of NT$96.804 billion of stocks, of which foreign and mainland investors net‑sold NT$79.54 billion, proprietary traders sold NT$35.579 billion, while only mutual funds bought NT$18.315 billion against the trend. The large‑scale foreign outflow and capital repatriation were the core drivers of today’s stock‑FX double‑hit.

Looking ahead, FX analysts and market experts say the short‑term fate of the TWD hinges on U.S. earnings reports and whether foreign capital withdrawals ease. The TWD is currently locked in a tug‑of‑war around the NT$32.6 level; if hot‑money outflows persist, the market could test the NT$32.8 barrier further downwards.

He reiterated the need to keep core inflation around 2%, indicating the BOJ still has room for further rate hikes. With the BOJ concluding its two‑day policy meeting on October 30, many market participants expect the bank to leave its policy rate at 1.25% unchanged, but the post‑meeting statement could signal room to raise rates to 1.5% as early as December. Prime Minister Kishida also said Japan will moderate the scale of debt issuance and strengthen the economy to boost investor confidence in the yen, providing yen support and keeping USD/JPY flat around the low of 157.68.

Subsequently, the National Association of Home Builders (NAHB) reported that U.S. home‑builder confidence unexpectedly fell 3 points in October to 29, the lowest since June 2012. The drop reflects higher mortgage rates and rising prices for energy‑related building materials due to Middle‑East conflict. However, as investors' concerns about rate‑driven AI impacts eased, U.S. Treasury yields rose, with the benchmark 10‑year yield rebounding from its biggest weekly decline in seven months, pushing USD/JPY up to a high of 158.54.
